Returns the instance of Awp0Folders which consists of Fnd0HomeFolder, Awp0MySearchFolder, Awp0ProjectDataFolder and Awp0FavoritesFolder in its contents property
Active Workspace Full Text Search Data Provider. This business object implements the full text search capabilities in the Active Workspace application

Awp0GetChildrenProvider represents the data provider to return the children of the input business object. The children returned is determined by the input includedPropertyNames list which defines the properties which are to be processed in order to collect the children to be returned. If the includedPropertyNames list is empty, then the properties which are processed to get the children is based on the _DefaultChildProperties and _DefaultPseudoFolder preferences. Please see the Preferences and Environment Variables Reference and the RichClient Interface Guide for information on configuring these preferences. Children for which the user does not have read-access or processed with properties in excludedPropertyNames list will be excluded from the returned list of children.

Awp0InboxProvider represents the data provider for the Inbox location. This object is used for paging data in the inbox page, so the entire contents of the Inbox need not be returned all at onceInbox Provider is used in the Active Workspace application

Awp0ObjectSetRowProvider represents the data provider for an objectSet. This object is used for paging data in an objectSet, so the entire contents of an objectSet table need not be returned all at once.Object Set Row Provider is used in the Active Workspace application
Provider for providing content of selected PseudoFolder
Recent Objects Provider

Active Workspace Where References Data Provider, and it finds all WorkspaceObjects in Teamcenter that reference the specified WorkspaceObject. This data provider generally is used in Where-Used tab at Active Workspace Client to display all reference objects for selected object.

Awp0ResourceProvider represents the data provider for the user selection panel. This object is used for paging data in the user selection panel, so the entire contents of the panel need not be returned all at once. The Resource Provider is used in the Active Workspace application

Awp0SavedQuerySearchProvider is primarily used by Active Workspace Client(AWC) to support Saved Query search. This Object has implementation logic for user selected saved query execution and returning search results.
Data provider for Awp0FullTextSavedSearch objects.
Provider for providing the Workflow signoffs data of WorkspaceObject.
Provider for Table Properties and Name Value Pairs

AWC Object Type Search Provider. This provider is primarily used by AWC to support search of a business object types available in database. It has implementation logic for querying business object types and returing the search results.

This is a runtime string array. It references Participant ImanType names that are to be displayed with the "Required" flag in the client. This property derives its value from its respective workflow's root task template's existing persistent attribute by the same name. It is used by the Assign participants user interface to filter out those participant types that are not used by the current workflow instance and differentiate those that are used for required assignments versus optional signoff assignments.

This is a runtime property of string array type. It will list all the participants which should be shown in the Participants page based on the preference WRKFLW_display_participants and active workflows. If WRKFLW_display_participants is set to allowable, it will list the names of all the participants associated with the selected object's type.If WRKFLW_display_participants is set to assignable, it will list the names of the assignable participants only which are used in the current workflows. i.e. if the object is in workflow; it will combine existing properties fnd0OptionalParticipants and fnd0RequiredParticipants and return those which are assignable by the current user.If the preference WRKFLW_display_participants is set to all_assignable, then show all the assignable participants ignoring current workflows if any.

This is a runtime boolean property that reflects if the current user can add an ad-hoc reviewer (signoff) at the perform signoff stage of a task. This property gets its value from execution of a BMIDE Condition called Fnd0AddReviewerPrivilege. Default condition value will be "1=1" which means it is true .

This is a runtime boolean property that reflects if the current user can add an ad-hoc task (Do ask or Review task) as a dependent subprocess to this task. This property gets its value from execution of a BMIDE Condition called Fnd0AddTaskPrivilege. Default condition value will be "1=1" which means its true.

ServiceInterface.description:
A global alternate part is interchangeable with another part in all circumstances, regardless of where the other part is used in the product structure. A global alternate applies to any revision of the part and is independent of any views. Parts and their global alternates are related only in a single direction. The GlobalAlternate Services exposes operations that are used to manage global alternates of the specified items, such as adding or removing global alternate.

The GlobalAlternate service can be used for supporting the following use-cases :

    • Add one or more global alternates to the list of global alternates of the selected item.
    • Remove selected global alternates from the list of global alternates of the selected item.
ServiceInterface.name: GlobalAlternate

ServiceInterface.description:
This service provides operations required to support the File Management System (FMS) functionality, and is intended to be used with the Active Workspace client. This service contains operations that run in the Teamcenter Server context to supply business logic functionality which controls the flow of user data. The data being controlled by this service exists within files, as represented by ImanFile objects within the Teamcenter Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.
This service provides the following file management use cases:
    • Manage PLM file downloads (reading a file from a Teamcenter volume).
    • Manage PLM file uploads (adding a file to a Teamcenter volume).
ServiceInterface.name: FileMgmt

OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Information required for the file replace operation is returned in LoadPlmdTicketReplaceResponse.The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 141170 Teamcenter ersion is less than 11.4.0.
    • 14167 An invalid Dataset object was provided.
    • 14168 Unable to create a PLMD file under transient volume due to FMS BootStrap errors.
    • 14169 Unable to create a PLMD file under transient volume due to Operating System directory permissions.

OperationParameter.description: Input information about the Dataset and file to be replaced.
OperationParameter.name: infos

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation fetches the name and the Teamcenter File Management System (FMS) ticket of the file, related to the input business objects of type Dataset, as the primary named reference. In case multiple files are related to the Dataset as primary named reference , this operation fetches the first file and its corresponding FMS ticket.

This operation can be invoked by the Active Workspace client with at least one of the input objects of type Dataset, this means Active Workspace client enables the Download command when at least one of the selected object is of type Dataset. This operation handles types other than Dataset gracefully and warns the user for the invalid selection.

The primary named reference of the Dataset is defined through its definition using the BMIDE tool of Teamcenter. This operation finds the primary named reference using the Tool Actions and the Reference definitions of the type Dataset. Tool Actions of the type Dataset defines the mapping of the operation on the Dataset with the named reference and the Reference definition of the Dataset maps the named reference and the extension of the file. Citing an example , if there are multiple files associated with the named reference i.e ‘Text’ , the first file associated with this named reference is selected. In case , the first file is deleted , the second file associated with this named reference takes precedence.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::FileMgmt::getFileNamesWithTicketInfo
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A list of file name and their corresponding FMS ticket for the first file of the primary named reference of every input Dataset.

The following partial error may be returned:

•    141365     ‘x’ of ‘y’ selections were downloaded.
•    141366     The object was not downloaded because it is not a dataset.
•    141367     The object was not downloaded because it is empty.

OperationParameter.description: A list of BusinessObject objects for which the file name and the its file ticket is to be retrieved.
OperationParameter.name: businessObjectsIn

This operation handles types other than Dataset gracefully and warns the user for the invalid selection.

The primary named reference of the Dataset is defined through its definition using the BMIDE tool of Teamcenter. This operation finds the primary named reference using the Tool Actions and the Reference definitions of the type Dataset. Tool Actions of the type Dataset defines the mapping of the operation on the Dataset with the named reference and the Reference definition of the Dataset maps the named reference and the extension of the file. Citing an example , if there are multiple files associated with the named reference i.e ‘Text’ , the first file associated with this named reference is selected. In case , the first file is deleted , the second file associated with this named reference takes precedence.

Operation.returnDescription:

The following partial error may be returned:

•    141366     The object was not downloaded because it is not a dataset.
•    141367     The object was not downloaded because it is empty.
Operation.useCase:
Use Case 1:
    In Active Workspace client, when user selects Dataset objects and clicks on the “Download” command then the client starts downloading the file directly from the FMS with the help of the FMS ticket information.

Use Case 2:
    In Active Workspace client, user selects the Dataset objects and clicks on the “Copy File Download Link” command to copy the URL of the file on the Teamcenter and OS clipboards. When the copied file download link is hit by the user on a different page then the client starts downloading the file directly from the FMS with the help of the FMS ticket information.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of BusinessObject objects for which the file name and the its file ticket is to be retrieved.

OperationTemplate.description: This operation queries for Object Directory Service (ODS) publication records at the target ODS site based on the input criteria and serializes the data into one or more TC XML files. The search criteria can be date based or a list of objects which have been previously published. Read tickets are returned for the generated TC XML files.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::MultiSite::fetchODSRecords
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
This operation returns a list of FMS read tickets to TC XML files containing PublicationRecord data, full paths to any relevent error logs and a list of faiiled objects in UID form. The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 100101 – Connection to ODS failed.
    • 100103 – Invalid ODS site supplied.
    • 100104 – Requesting client site has no access to ODS.
    • 100014 – User has no read access to publication record.
    • 11045 – Invalid TIE option supplied.
    • 11184 – Invalid TIE session option supplied.

OperationParameter.description: The name of the site to interrogate.
OperationParameter.name: odsSiteName

OperationParameter.description:
Specifies the type of search, valid values are:
    • 0: Search for Publication Record by last publication date including deleted Publication Record.
    • 1: Search for Publication Records by creation date.
    • 2: Search for Publication Records by UIDs.
    • 3: Set up the environment for tracking deleted Publication Records.
    • 4: Clean up the deleted Publication Records by deletion date.
OperationParameter.name: searchMode

OperationParameter.description: The beginning date of the record search. The format is “YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS”. Required by search modes 0 and 1. Not used by search mode 2 and 3.
OperationParameter.name: startDate

OperationParameter.description: The end date of the record search. The format is “YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS”. Required by search modes 0 and 1. Not used by search mode 2 and 3.
OperationParameter.name: endDate

OperationParameter.description: A list of PublicationRecord business objects to search for in UID format for search mode 2. Not used by search modes 0, 1, 3 and 4.
OperationParameter.name: pubrList

OperationParameter.description:
A map (string, list of strings) of search option keys and a list of key values. Supported key values:
    • batchSize : The maximum number of records to be returned in a single TCXML file. Search results that are larger will be returned in multiple files. The lowest supported value is 5000. Batch size will be set to 5000 if a lower value is supplied.
    • searchTypeList: Limit the search to Business Object types in this list.
OperationParameter.name: odsSessionInfo

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation retrieves the information about the FullText dataset versions for the given Requirements. It also retrieves the contents and properties of the FullText dataset which are displayed in the user interface.
The following partial errors may be returned:
159001: An internal error has occurred in the Requirements Management module. Please report this error to your system administrator.
141308: The type of operation to perform in invalid.
141309: The selected input object does not contain FullText object.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::RequirementsManagement::getFullTextVersionInfo
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
If successful, the Requirement Revision and its FullText dataset versions and its contents will be returned along with the ServiceData. If an error occurs then ServiceData will contain partial error.
The following partial errors may be returned:
159001 An internal error has occurred in the Requirements Management module. Please report this error to your system administrator.
141308 The type of operation to perform in invalid.
141309 The selected input object does not contain FullText object.

OperationParameter.description: List of objects of type Requirement Revision or Arm0RequirementElement to get the FullText dataset versions.

OperationTemplate.description: This operation creates a FND_TraceLink object between the primary and secondary business objects.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::RequirementsManagement::createTracelinks
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A list of CreateTracelinksResponseData structures, one for each successfully created FND_TraceLink object corresponding to each input and the ServiceData. Any failure will be returned with clientId mapped to error message in the ServiceData list of partial errors. Following error codes are returned in the ServiceData.

    • 141300 -The trace link was not created because both start and end items must be occurrences.
    • 141301 -The trace link was not created because either the start or end item is a context root element.
    • 141302 - The trace link was not created because either the start or end item is missing.
    • 141303 - The "trace link relation" cannot be created between a "object type" and a "object type".
    • 141304 - The trace link was not created because the relation "trace link relation" already exists between the start and end items.
    • 141305 - The trace link was not created because the end item needs to be an occurrence.
    • 141306 - The trace link was not created because the start item needs to be an occurrence.

OperationParameter.description: Structures which hold the required information to create tracelinks between the given business objects.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation will exports the selected occurrences in the structure to the application such as MSWord and MSExcel. The behavior of export operation is controlled by applicationFormat argument specified in ExportToApplicationInput2 structure.
Following are supported application formats from input.

    • MSExcelLive - This mode provides the capability of editing of properties of underlying ItemRevision in MSExcel and save the changes to Teamcenter. The generated sheet allows user to login and change the properties from MSExcel application. The changes will be saved to Teamcenter when user exits out of the cell in MSExcel application. Teamcenter extensions for Microsoft Office should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSWordXMLLive - This mode provides the capability of structural editing of SpecElementRevisions in MSWord. Users can edit the rich text of Requirement and perform structural changes to the exported Requirement(s) in the word document. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSExcel - This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to static MSExcel application.
    • MSExcelReimport- This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to MSExcel application for reimport purpose. The generated sheet can be used to for add/remove structure elements or to update the properties on the SpecElement revision. The generated sheet should be reimported back to Teamcenter. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSWordCompare - This mode provides the capability of comparing the contents of source and target objects using MSWord application. The comparison document is generated asynchonously in the background and user is notified when the comparison document is generated. Dispatcher and notification services should be running to support this application format.
    • HTML- This mode provides the capability of fetching the HTML contents of input SpecElement objects.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::RequirementsManagement::exportToApplication
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The contents of the input SpecElements and the transient file read tickets of the exported file. The following partial errors may be returned.
    • 126001:An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
    • 126002:No Adapter could be found to handle the Product. The system has not been adequately enhanced or customised to deal with the data given to it as input.
    • 126003:The selected input object is not an BusinessObject of type Awb0Element.
    • 126004:The supported application formats are MSExcel, MSWordXMLLive, MSExcelLive, MSExcelReimport, MSWordCompare and HTML.

OperationParameter.description: Input for the operation to export the selected occurrences to MSWord or MSExcel.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation creates baseline of the selected business object.The selected object can be of type ItemRevision or Awb0Element .Baseline is a mechanism to to preserve the current state of the object in time . This is asynchronous operation and is invoked by synchronous service operation createBaseline . createBaselineAsync operation performs the actual baseline creation. When the business object selected for baselining is a structure occurrence of type Awb0Element, new baseline revisions are created for all the occurrences in that structure. When the selected business object is of type ItemRevision, then a single baseline revision is created. User is notified after baseline creation is complete.

This operation will be used internally and will not be published.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::RequirementsManagement::createBaseline
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: If an error occurs then ServiceData will contain partial error.

OperationParameter.description: The BaselineInputData represents the data required to baseline selected object.

Operation.description:
This operation retrieves the information about the FullText dataset versions for the given Requirements. It also retrieves the contents and properties of the FullText dataset which are displayed in the user interface.
The following partial errors may be returned:
159001: An internal error has occurred in the Requirements Management module. Please report this error to your system administrator.
141308: The type of operation to perform in invalid.
141309: The selected input object does not contain FullText object.
Operation.name: getFullTextVersionInfo
Operation.returnDescription:
If successful, the Requirement Revision and its FullText dataset versions and its contents will be returned along with the ServiceData. If an error occurs then ServiceData will contain partial error.
The following partial errors may be returned:
159001 An internal error has occurred in the Requirements Management module. Please report this error to your system administrator.
141308 The type of operation to perform in invalid.
141309 The selected input object does not contain FullText object.
Operation.useCase:
Use Case 1: Get FullText dataset versions and contents
User selects a Requirement in Home folder. User goes to History tab where document history list will be displayed.This document history list will contain information about all the Requirement Revision and its FullText dataset versions and its contents. User selects any two FullText dataset versions and clicks on compare which will give compare HTML report.

Use Case 2: Get FullText dataset versions during Freeze of derived Requirement
User loads the requirement specification in ACE (Active Content Experience) panel. User clicks on 'Reuse' command which shows the 'Reuse and Derived' panel. User selects 'Create a derived Specification' and selects a tracelink type and clicks on Create button. This creates a derived of the existing Requirement specification. User selects a derived Requirement and clicks on 'Freeze' option which shows the FullText dataset versions. User will pick a version and clicks on Ok button. This will freeze the Requirement and it will show the contents from the dataset version that user had picked.

ParameterInfo.description: List of objects of type Requirement Revision or Arm0RequirementElement to get the FullText dataset versions.

Operation.description:
This operation creates baseline of the selected business object.The selected object can be of type ItemRevision or Awb0Element .Baseline is a mechanism to to preserve the current state of the object in time . This is a synchronous operation and it returns back immediately with partial errors if any. This operation calls createBaselineAsync (asynchronous service operation) which performs the actual baseline creation. When the business object selected for baselining is a structure occurrence of type Awb0Element, new baseline revision is created for all the occurrences in that structure. When the selected business object is of type ItemRevision, then a single baseline revision is created. User is notified after baseline creation is complete.

This operation is for Teamcenter internal use and is unpublished.
Operation.name: createBaseline
Operation.returnDescription:
If an error occurs then ServiceData will contain partial error.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141089 - The Object "Object A" was not saved because it is an unsupported type.
Operation.useCase:
1. User loads a structure in ACE (Active Content Experience) panel. The ACE panel is used for smart navigation of occurrences in a structure.
User selects an occurrence and in Tool and Info command bar, clicks on 'Save As or Revise' option. This will show up a panel with tab options as "Revision" and "New". In Revision tab, 'Save as Baseline' checkbox is present. After selecting this checkbox, 'Baseline Template' dropdown box appears. The user selects a baseline template from dropdown followed by a click on "Save" button, resulting into baseline creation. Irrespective of the selected occurrence, after clicking "Save"; the entire structure ie. top most parent occurrence and all its children are baselined. When the baseline creation completes, a notification is sent to the client.

2. User selects an ItemRevision in non ACE view and in Tool and Info command bar clicks on 'Save As or Revise' option. This will show up a panel with tab options as "Revision" and "New". After selecting this checkbox, 'Baseline Template' dropdown box appears. In Revision tab, 'Save as Baseline' checkbox is present. The user selects a baseline template from dropdown followed by a click on "Save" button, resulting into baseline creation for this item revision. When the baseline creation completes, a notification is sent to the client.

ParameterInfo.description: The BaselineInputData represents the data required to baseline selected object.

Operation.description: This operation creates a FND_TraceLink object between the primary and secondary business objects.
Operation.name: createTracelinks
Operation.returnDescription:
A list of CreateTracelinksResponseData structures, one for each successfully created FND_TraceLink object corresponding to each input and the ServiceData. Any failure will be returned with clientId mapped to error message in the ServiceData list of partial errors. Following error codes are returned in the ServiceData.

    • 141300 -The trace link was not created because both start and end items must be occurrences.
    • 141301 -The trace link was not created because either the start or end item is a context root element.
    • 141302 - The trace link was not created because either the start or end item is missing.
    • 141303 - The "trace link relation" cannot be created between a "object type" and a "object type".
    • 141304 - The trace link was not created because the relation "trace link relation" already exists between the start and end items.
    • 141305 - The trace link was not created because the end item needs to be an occurrence.
    • 141306 - The trace link was not created because the start item needs to be an occurrence.
Operation.useCase:
In ACE perspective, user select an Awb0Element element and clicks on the “Create TraceLink” button. The selected element will be in the Create Trace Link panel start section, user chooses another Awb0Element element in the Create Trace Link panel end section.

    • If createTracelinkWithOccurrences mode is true, the trace link between the Occurrences will be created.
    • If createDefiningTracelinkWithOccurrence is true, then the trace link between the defining Occurrence and the complying underlying workspace object will be created.
    • If createComplyingTracelinkWithOccurrence is true, then the trace link between the defining underlying workspace object and the complying Occurrence will be created.

ParameterInfo.description: Structures which hold the required information to create tracelinks between the given business objects.

Operation.description:
This operation exports the selected occurrences in the structure asynchronously to an application such as MSExcel. The behavior of export operation is controlled by applicationFormat argument specified in ExportInputDataAsync structure. The objects may be checked out during the export.

Following are supported application formats from input.

    • MSExcelLive - This mode provides the capability of editing of properties of underlying ItemRevision in MSExcel and save the changes to Teamcenter. The generated sheet allows user to login and change the properties from MSExcel application. The changes will be saved to Teamcenter when user exits out of the cell in MSExcel application. Teamcenter extensions for Microsoft Office should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSExcel - This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to static MSExcel application.
    • MSExcelReimport - This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to MSExcel application for reimport purpose. The generated sheet can be used to add/remove structure elements or to update the properties on the SpecElementRevision. The generated sheet should be reimported back to Teamcenter. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format
Operation.name: exportAsync
Operation.returnDescription: This is an asynchronous method, there is no return value.
Operation.useCase:
• User loads a structure in ACE (Active Content Experience) panel. The ACE panel is used for smart navigation of occurrences in a structure.User selects an occurrence and clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This will show a panel with options to "View", "Live Edit" and "Edit and Import". This panel allows user to select a template and if user clicks on Export button, an Excel sheet will be generated. If user has selected a single occurrence and clicks on export, then the occurrence and all its children are exported to MSExcel. If user has selected multiple occurrences and clicks on export, then the selected occurrences are exported to MSExcel.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client. User clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. User can select View, Edit or Reimport option. Depending upon the option selected, a static MSExcel report or a Live MSExcel sheet or a sheet is generated that can be reimported back to Teamcenter.
    • User selects an ItemRevision and clicks on the Export to Excel button on the toolbar. If user selects "Check out" option then selected ItemRevision and its children will be checked out and exported to MSExcel.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in ActiveWorkspace Client. User selects the background checkbox in the export panel and clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This will invoke the Export to Excel using the async service options. When the Export to Excel completes, a notification is sent to the client to download the Excel file. The generated file is also attached to the MSExcelX dataset.
    • User selects the "apply_bom_crawling" LOV value on the ExcelTemplate and selects an occurrence in ACE and clicks on Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This will crawlback from the selected object to its parent's recursively till its top line and the exported structure will export the selected line along with its parents.

DeprecationInfo.deprecatedDescription: This operation is deprecated and replaced by Awp0::Soa::Internal::AWS2::_2017_06::RequirementsManagement::exportAsync2

ParameterInfo.description: Input for the operation to export the selected objects to MSExcel.

Operation.description:
This operation exports the selected occurrences in the structure asynchronously to an application such as MSExcel and MSWord. The behavior of export operation is controlled by applicationFormat and objectTemplateInputs arguments specified in ExportInputDataAsync2 structure. If user selects the "include attachments" option, then this operation can export a .zip file that will include all the attachments associated with the selected object along with the document. The objects may be checked out during the export.

Following are supported application formats from input.

    • MSExcelLive - This mode provides the capability of editing of properties of underlying ItemRevision in MSExcel and save the changes to Teamcenter. The generated sheet allows user to login and change the properties from MSExcel application. The changes will be saved to Teamcenter when user exits out of the cell in MSExcel application. Teamcenter extensions for Microsoft Office should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSExcel - This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to static MSExcel application.
    • MSExcelReimport - This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to MSExcel application for reimport purpose. The generated sheet can be used to add/remove structure elements or to update the properties on the SpecElementRevision. The generated sheet should be reimported back to Teamcenter. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSWordXMLLive - This mode provides the capability of structural editing of SpecElementRevision in MSWord. Users can edit the rich text of Requirements and perform structural changes to the exported Requirements in the word document. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
Operation.name: exportAsync2
Operation.returnDescription: This is an asynchronous method, there is no return value.
Operation.useCase:
• User loads a structure in ACE (Active Content Experience) panel. The ACE panel is used for smart navigation of occurrences in a structure. User selects an occurrence and clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This will show a panel with options to "View", "Live Edit" and "Edit and Import". This panel allows user to select a template and if user clicks on Export button, an Excel sheet will be generated. If user has selected a single occurrence and clicks on export, then the occurrence and all its children are exported to MSExcel. If user has selected multiple occurrences and clicks on export, then the selected occurrences are exported to MSExcel.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client. User clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. User can select View, Edit or Reimport option. Depending upon the option selected, a static MSExcel report or a Live MSExcel sheet or a sheet is generated that can be reimported back to Teamcenter.
    • User selects an ItemRevision and clicks on the Export to Excel button on the toolbar. If user selects "Check out" option then selected ItemRevision and its children will be checked out and exported to MSExcel.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in ActiveWorkspace Client. User selects the background checkbox in the export panel and clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This will invoke the Export to Excel using the async service options. When the Export to Excel completes, a notification is sent to the client to download the Excel file. The generated file is also attached to the MSExcelX dataset.
    • User selects the "apply_bom_crawling" LOV value on the ExcelTemplate and selects an occurrence in ACE and clicks on Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This will crawlback from the selected object to its parent's recursively till its top line and the exported structure will export the selected line along with its parents.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in ActiveWorkspace Client. User selects the background checkbox in the export panel and clicks on the Export to Word button in the toolbar. This will invoke the Export to MSWord using the async service options. When the Export to MSWord completes, a notification is sent to the client to download the file.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client, and clicks on Export to Word button on the toolbar. User may select the Object Template that will be applied on the exported document.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in Active workspace client and clicks on Export to Word button on the toolbar. If the user selects "Include attachments"option, then a zip file will be exported that includes the Word document along with all the attachments associated with the selected object.

Operation.description:
This operation will exports the selected occurrences in the structure to the application such as MSWord and MSExcel. The behavior of export operation is controlled by applicationFormat argument specified in ExportToApplicationInput2 structure.
Following are supported application formats from input.

    • MSExcelLive - This mode provides the capability of editing of properties of underlying ItemRevision in MSExcel and save the changes to Teamcenter. The generated sheet allows user to login and change the properties from MSExcel application. The changes will be saved to Teamcenter when user exits out of the cell in MSExcel application. Teamcenter extensions for Microsoft Office should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSWordXMLLive - This mode provides the capability of structural editing of SpecElementRevisions in MSWord. Users can edit the rich text of Requirement and perform structural changes to the exported Requirement(s) in the word document. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSExcel - This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to static MSExcel application.
    • MSExcelReimport- This mode provides the capability of exporting objects to MSExcel application for reimport purpose. The generated sheet can be used to for add/remove structure elements or to update the properties on the SpecElement revision. The generated sheet should be reimported back to Teamcenter. Office Client should be installed on the client machine to support this application format.
    • MSWordCompare - This mode provides the capability of comparing the contents of source and target objects using MSWord application. The comparison document is generated asynchonously in the background and user is notified when the comparison document is generated. Dispatcher and notification services should be running to support this application format.
    • HTML- This mode provides the capability of fetching the HTML contents of input SpecElement objects.
Operation.name: exportToApplication
Operation.returnDescription:
The contents of the input SpecElements and the transient file read tickets of the exported file. The following partial errors may be returned.
    • 126001:An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
    • 126002:No Adapter could be found to handle the Product. The system has not been adequately enhanced or customised to deal with the data given to it as input.
    • 126003:The selected input object is not an BusinessObject of type Awb0Element.
    • 126004:The supported application formats are MSExcel, MSWordXMLLive, MSExcelLive, MSExcelReimport, MSWordCompare and HTML.
Operation.useCase:
• User loads a structure in ACE (Active Content Experience) panel. The ACE panel is used for smart navigation of occurrences in a structure. User selects an occurrence and clicks on the Export To Word or Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This action will allow users to select a template that will be used for export purpose. If user has selected a single occurrence and clicks on export, then the occurrence and all its children are exported to MSWord or MSExcel. If user has selected multiple occurrences and clicks on export, then the selected occurrences are exported to MSWord or MSExcel.
    • User selects single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client. User clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. User can select View, Edit or Reimport option. Depending upon the option selected, a static MSExcel report or a Live MSExcel sheet or a sheet is generated that can be reimported back to Teamcenter.
    • User select s single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client and sets them as source objects to compare. Similarly user selects single or multiple target objects to compare. User clicks on the Export to Word button in the toolbar along with the checkbox for compare contents. User selects the compare contents checkbox that allows user to compare the MSWord contents of source and target objects. User is notified when the comparison document is generated and attached to a dataset.
    • User selects a SpecElement created from Active Workspace client and clicks on the Viewer tab. The HTML contents of the selected SpecElement is shown in the Viewer tab.

The contents of the input SpecElements and the transient file read tickets of the exported file.

The following partial errors may be returned:
126001 An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.

Operation.useCase:
1) User loads a structure in ACE (Active Content Experience) panel. The ACE panel is used for smart navigation of occurrences in a structure.
User selects an occurrence and clicks on the Export To Word or Export to Excel button in the toolbar. This action will allow users to select a template that will be used for export purpose. If user has selected a single occurrence and clicks on export, then the occurrence and all its children are exported to MSWord or MSExcel. If user has selected multiple occurrences and clicks on export, then the selected occurrences are exported to MSWord or MSExcel.

2) User selects single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client. User clicks on the Export to Excel button in the toolbar. User can select View, Edit or Reimport option. Depending upon the option selected, a static MSExcel report or a Live MSExcel sheet or a sheet is generated that can be reimported back to Teamcenter.
3) User selects single or multiple objects in Active Workspace Client and sets them as source objects to compare. Similarly user selects single or multiple target objects to compare. User clicks on the Export to Word button in the toolbar along with the checkbox for compare contents. User selects the compare contents checkbox that allows user to compare the MSWord contents of source and target objects. User is notified when the comparison document is generated and attached to a dataset.
4) User selects a SpecElement created from Active Workspace client and clicks on the Viewer tab. The HTML contents of the selected SpecElement is shown in the Viewer tab.
5) User selects an ItemRevision and clicks on the Export To Word or Export to Excel button in on the toolbar. If user selects "Check out" option then selected occurrences ItemRevision and its children will be checked out and exported to MSWord or MSExcel.

Operation.description: This operation retrieves export templates from database.These export templates are of type SpecTemplate and ExcelTemplate that are used to exporting Teamcenter objects to Office applications using the template option. The templates are retrieved based on the input filter.
Operation.name: getExportTemplates
Operation.returnDescription: The GetExportTemplateResponse structure contains the information about type of template and the display name of the template. The type of template can be "SpecTemplate" or "ExcelTemplate".

ParameterInfo.description: The filter to determine the type of export templates to fetch based on the input Teamcenter objects like Item and ItemRevision. Valid values are "SpecTemplate", "ExcelTemplate" or both.

Operation.description: This SOA operation sets the body text property of a FullText object to the supplied html or pain text content. The SOA operation is called when a user modifies requirements in the active workspace client. It accepts SpecElement Revision or FullText objects to process. All modified objects and exceptions are added to the returned service data.
Operation.name: setRichContent
Operation.returnDescription: The objecs will be returned in the 'plain' slot of the ServiceData with partial errors for any UID that is not valid or references an object the user does not have asscess to.

ParameterInfo.description: A vecrtor of setContentInputs

Operation.description: This operation sets the contents of the FullText or SpecElementRevision object. The input content type can be 'HTML', 'Plain' or 'RichText' type. All modified objects and exceptions are added to the returned service data. Additionally this operation will prevent the user from overwriting the contents of FullText or SpecElementRevision object, when multiple users are trying to update contents of same object by comparing last saved date of FullText object.
Operation.name: setRichContent2
Operation.returnDescription:
The objects will be returned in the 'plain' slot of the ServiceData with partial errors for any UID that is not valid or references an object the user does not have access to. Additionally following possible error returned in Service Data.
141023 The object has been modified. Please refresh the object before editing. If the object is modified by another user since it was in edit mode, this error will be shown to the user
Operation.useCase:
1. User selects a object of type SpecElement created from Active Workspace client and clicks on the Viewer tab. The HTML contents of the selected SpecElement type is shown in the Viewer tab. User can set rich text contents of Requirement object by using setRichContent2 operation.

2. When multiple users edit a requirement's content concurrently and try to save using setRichContent2 operation. It prevent user from overwriting changes of another user for the same requirement by comparing last saved date of FullText object.

ParameterInfo.description: A vector of setContentInputs

ServiceInterface.description: This service provides a variety of operations for advanced saved searches. Operations include creating and updating advanced saved searches.
ServiceInterface.name: AdvancedSavedSearch

Struct.description: Contians a list of newly created saved searches and the service data containing partial errors if any.
Struct.name: Awp0AdvancedSavedSearchResponse

StructElement.description: A List of SavedSearch objects created or modified by a service operation.
StructElement.name: savedSearchList

StructElement.description: Returned service data.
StructElement.name: serviceData

Struct.description: Input structure for createAdvancedSavedSearch operation.
Struct.name: Awp0CreateAdvancedSavedSearchInput

StructElement.description:
A map (string, string) to hold string value inputs, valid keys are followings:
    • “savedSearchName” The name of saved search.
    • “referencingSavedQuery” The saved query this saved search is created based off.
    • “targetFolder” The target Folder the saved search will be created in.
    • “clientId” This unique ID is used to identify return data elements and partial errors associated with this input structure.
StructElement.name: stringValueInputKeyValuePairs

StructElement.description:
A map (string, bool) to hold bool value inputs, valid keys are followings:
    • “shareSavedSearch” Allow other users to view and execute the saved search. If true, other users can see and execute the saved search; otherwise not visible to other users.

If true and a SavedSearch object having same name owned by current user already exists then delete the existing SavedSearch object and create a new one.

Operation.description: This operation is used to get the search setting values from the server. These search settings are displayed at the client side to make search more configurable and convenient for user. Client needs to render these setting in user undersandable formate so that users can customize search based on their requirement.
Operation.name: getSearchSettings
Operation.returnDescription: Returns the search setting values to the client based on input criteria.
Operation.useCase:
Search setting has one of the attributes which is used to configure the category names for which the filters are expanded by default after every search.
Right now these values are configured using preference AWC_Limited_Filter_Categories_Expanded this preference takes <typename>.<property name> as input. For example, user needs to set value as WorkspaceObject.object_type if only object_type filter category needs to be expanded.

When we are giving an option to configure this value from client, we want user to use display names instead of internal names of the type and property to make it more user understandable. Display values in this case will be fetched by this new service.

ParameterInfo.description: Input structure to set the setting names for which the values are required.

ServiceInterface.description:
The Advanced Search service contains operations that expose the SavedQuery functionality in Active Workspace (AW). AW already provides the full text search capability. This functionality provides the advanced search capabilities provided by SavedQuery in Teamcenter
This service supports the following use-cases.

    • Creation of the AdvancedCriteria object to collect user input for Advanced Query Criteria

StructElement.name: lov

StructElement.description: This is a container of key-value pairs representing the desired entries for different property fields for different operations (Create, SaveAs, Revise, etc.). It is used for context-based evaluation of the LOV values where the property values are substituted into query criteria. It is also used for interdependent LOV evaluation e.g to evaluate interdependent LOV values at dependent levels given the values at the higher levels that are populated on the lovInput
StructElement.name: lovInput

StructElement.description: The name of the Property for which LOV is being evaluated.
StructElement.name: propertyName

StructElement.description: Filter critieria and other search data.
StructElement.name: filterData

Struct.description: Container of data such as LOV usage, Style, Lov Column Names. Additionally it contains interdependent properties that can be used for optimization by the client
Struct.name: LOVBehaviorData

StructElement.description: Indicates if LOV is exhaustive (=1) or suggestive(=2) or Range (=3)
StructElement.name: lovUsage

StructElement.description: Possible values are Standard, Range, Hierarchical, Interdependent and Coordinated Standard - A simple list of values Interdependent - An interdependent list of values, where each value has a nested list of values. A list of States would have a list of Cities for each State. For this style of LOV the dependentProps will have a list of property names that are associated with each level of the LOV hierarchy Hierarchical - Same as the Interdependent, but only the last level of values is associated with a property Coordinated - This is similar to Interdependent; however levels 2-N will only have a single value. When the user selects a value from the first level LOV, the system can then fill property values for all levels Range - Subset (ranges) of valid values in terms of upper and lower ranges
StructElement.name: style

StructElement.description: Names of the columns when displayed in clients
StructElement.name: columnNames

StructElement.description: This is a list of Boolean values that indicates if the description for each of the column properties is attached
StructElement.name: descriptionsAttached

StructElement.description: Names of interdependent properties. If the LOV is not an interdependent or coordinated LOV, this list will be empty
StructElement.name: dependendProps

StructElement.description: Upper limit for Range LOV. This is not applicable to any other style of LOV
StructElement.name: rangeUpperLimit

StructElement.description: Lower limit for Range LOV. This is not applicable to any other style of LOV
StructElement.name: rangeLowerLimit

Struct.description: Structure containing column names for the LOV value property, LOV description property and the filter attributes
Struct.name: LOVColumnNames

StructElement.description: The attribute on the object to be used as the LOV value. When the user selects a row from the list of values in the dynamic LOV widget (an item for example), this configuration point tells the system which attribute to use as the LOV value. In case of Static LOVs, the name of the property is returned as "lov_value". In case of Dynamic LOVs, it is a name as specified in BMIDE.
StructElement.name: lovValueProp

StructElement.description: The attribute on the object to be used as the LOV value description. When the user selects a row from the list of values in the dynamic LOV widget (an item for example), this configuration point tells the system which attribute to use as the LOV value description. In case of Static LOVs, the name of the property is returned as "lov_value_description". In case of Dynamic LOVs, it is a name as specified in BMIDE. It can be have empty value if it is not specified by BMIDE administrator.
StructElement.name: lovDescrProp

StructElement.description: The filter properties would appear as additional columns along with the LOV Value and LOV description in the Dynamic LOV
StructElement.name: filterProperties

StructElement.description: Displayable names for each of lovValueProp, lovDescrProp, filterProperties that clients can use to display the same
StructElement.name: displayNames

Struct.description: This data structure is not for end user consumption. Data in this structure will be used by server for returning the next set of LOV values
Struct.name: LOVData

StructElement.description: Possible values are Standard, Dynamic, Range, Hierarchical, Interdependent and Coordinated
StructElement.name: style

StructElement.description: Filter critieria and other search data.
StructElement.name: filterData

StructElement.description: These are the list of UIDs that will be processed by the server in subsequent calls to get next set of LOV values
StructElement.name: unProcessedObjects

StructElement.description: Boolean flag to indicate if additional UIDs (Values in static LOV) are skipped or not
StructElement.name: additionalValuesSkipped

StructElement.description: Current index of the LOV results that have been processed.
StructElement.name: currentIndex

StructElement.description: LOVs of Dynamic LOV which is being evaluated
StructElement.name: lovs

Struct.description: Filter Data used in InitialLOVData.
Struct.name: LovFilterData

StructElement.description: The desired string used to filter the search results. For example, if "Green" is entered as a filter string, the results returned for LOV values will include the LOV values that match the query criteria AND contain the string "Green" in the LOV Description or any of the filter attributes. Case sensitive nature is honoured based on TC_ignore_case_on_search preference.
StructElement.name: filterString

StructElement.description: Maximum number of LOV results that server should retrieve from the database
StructElement.name: maxResults

StructElement.description: Number of objects to be processed in case of dynamic LOVs to return LOV values and in other LOV cases it is to return the number of LOV values from the LOV results. This number must be less than or equal to maxResults
StructElement.name: numberToReturn

StructElement.description: Property name on which to sort the results. This is optional
StructElement.name: sortPropertyName

If an operation does not have an object, specify the value as null and ensure boName is passed for the same. For example, during creation, client does not have an object. Struct.description: This structure contains information for a column configuration within a client scope URI. It contains a unique column config id, a list of column definition information, and the operation type used to finalize the columns.
Struct.name: ColumnConfig

StructElement.description: The unique identifier of the column configuration.
StructElement.name: columnConfigId

StructElement.description:
The operation that was used to finalize the columns to be returned back.
Supported values are:
"Intersection", "Union" and "Configured".
StructElement.name: operationType

StructElement.description: List of column details.
StructElement.name: columns

Struct.description: Contains input information required to retrieve UI column configurations from the Teamcenter database.
Struct.name: ColumnConfigInput

StructElement.description:
The name of a client application, as represented by an instance of Fnd0Client in the Teamcenter database. This value must match the value of fnd0ClientName property.
For example: The client name for Active Workspace is "AWClient".
StructElement.name: clientName

StructElement.description:
Specifies the name of a hosting client application, as represented by an instance of Fnd0Client, in the Teamcenter databases. This value must match a value of the fnd0ClientName property.

For example: If client A is integrated with client B and the user can invoke client B commands from within client A, the input to getUiConfigs3 service operation would specify client A as hosting client and client B as the client. If the caller wanted native commands for client A, client A would be specified as client and hosting client would be empty.
StructElement.name: hostingClientName

StructElement.description:
The unique name of the client scope containing column configurations.
For example: "Awp0SearchResults" is the client scope URI for search location.
StructElement.name: clientScopeURI

StructElement.description:
The operation that needs to be applied to finalize the columns to be returned back.
Valid values are:
"Intersection" - Gets the intersection of the columns for the types found in search results.
"Union" - Gets all the columns for the types found in search results.
"Configured" - Gets all the columns defined for requested scope irrespective of types passed in. If it does not find any configuration at the specified scope it will search up in the order of scopes User, Role, Group and Site. No need to pass type names if need to fetch all columns.
StructElement.name: operationType

StructElement.description:
List of columns which should be excluded from the final list being returned. The value provided should be in the format "TypeName.PropertyName". Both type name and property name should be internal values.
For example: ItemRevision.sequence_id, where '.' is the delimiter
StructElement.name: columnsToExclude

Struct.description: Contains details about a specific column. This includes the type of object for which the column is applicable, the name of the property displayed in the column, a flag indicating if the column should be used to order information displayed in the client, pixel width of the column, a flag indicating if the column should be hidden and the column sort order.
Struct.name: ColumnDefInfo

StructElement.description: The business object type for the value displayed in the column. This can be any valid Teamcenter business object type.
StructElement.name: typeName

StructElement.description: The property name for the value displayed in the column.
StructElement.name: propertyName

StructElement.description: The pixel width for the column. Valid pixel widths are integer values between 1 and 500.
StructElement.name: pixelWidth

StructElement.description: The column order value is used to arrange the columns in order.
StructElement.name: columnOrder

StructElement.description: If true, the column should be hidden on the client user interface.
StructElement.name: hiddenFlag

"Configured" - Gets all the columns defined for requested scope irrespective of types passed in. If it does not find any configuration at the specified scope it will search up in the order of scopes User, Role, Group and Site. No need to pass type names if need to fetch all columns.

Typedef.description:
The map of (string, string) filter parameters.
Following are the possible values.
1. Key "scope", Value could be "session" or "all". If the value is passed as "session", only the workspaces which match other filter parameters and apply to current user session (group role combination) will be returned. If it is passed as "all", all the workspaces in the system matching other filters will be returned regardless of existing user session.
2. Key "group", Value needs to be the group ID to which associated workspaces needs to be loaded. Key "group" is optional. If it is not present in operation input, all the workspaces matching other filters will be returned.
3. Key "role", Value needs to be the role ID to which associated workspaces needs to be loaded. Key "role" is optional. If it is not present in operation input, all the workspaces matching other filters will be returned.
Typedef.name: FilterParams

Struct.description:
Input structure containing option value to query and update the objects among newly added, modified, deleted or all. It also includes a boolean dryRun flag.

The queryAndUpdateOptions value is passed to skip or process in finding and updating the newly added, modified, deleted objects. Typedef.description:
A map containing information generated during the operation execution.
This includes information like count of objects found as newly added or modified or deleted that need to be synced. It can also contain other information like logfile names etc... needed by the caller.

The syncInfo will contain "STATUSCOUNT" as key and value is a list of strings as mentioned below with the counts of the objects found for the respective queries. Additional key/value pairs can be supported in future.
ADDED:<Count>
DELETED:<Count>
MODIFIED:<Count>
MODIFIED VIA RELATION:<Count>
Typedef.name: SyncInfo

Struct.description:
Contains the action to perform when the Awp0Tile is clicked in the Gateway. If ‘url’ is populated then ‘url’ parameters may optionally be populated in actionParams depending on the Tile2 configuration. If commandId is populated, then command arguments may optionally be populated in actionParams depending on the Awp0Tile configuration.

If the Awp0TileTemplate object’s awp0ActionType property is 0, 1 or 2 then the url property is populated. If the Awp0TileTemplate object’s awp0ActionType property is 3, then the commandId property is populated.
Struct.name: Action

StructElement.description: Identifies the action type. Possible values are 0 (default), 1 (external reference), 2 (static resource), 3 (command).
StructElement.name: actionType

StructElement.description: The URL to navigate to in the client if commandId is undefined.
StructElement.name: url

StructElement.description: The command ID to execute if URL is undefined.
StructElement.name: commandId

StructElement.description:
Optional command parameters. The names and values for this field come directly from the awp0Params property on the Awp0Tile object. These params are an unconstrained list of name/value pairs.

The syntax for awp0Params on the Awp0Tile object is in the format of <name>=<value>;<name2>=<value2>;<name3>=<value3>... Where name/value pairs are delimited by semicolon.

The awp0Params entry is parsed, and each name/value pair is added to a string map, where key is the parameter name, and the value is the parameter value.

For example: awp0Params may contain an entry such as “refresh=true;filter=POM_application_object.owning_user”.

The resulting map would contain the following parsed pairs:

“refresh”:”true”,
“filter”:”POM_application_object.owning_user”
StructElement.name: actionParams

Typedef.description: Contains optional command information to execute after the url or command ID is executed.

StructElement.description:
A map (string, string) used to perform the search.
For full text search, the key is "searchString", the value is input text. For example, ("searchString" : "*" | "?" | "string").

For advanced search, the supported key/values are:
("typeOfSearch" : "QUICK_SEARCH" or "ADVANCED_SEARCH");
("queryUID" : UID to a WorkspaceObject);
("searchID" : UID to a WorkspaceObject);
("quickSearchAttributeValue" : search string).

For example, an advance search might be:
"typeOfSearch" : "QUICK_SEARCH";
"queryUID" : "UID";
"searchID" : "UID";
"quickSearchAttributeValue": "*"

A map (string, string) used to define the different options for importing the table configurations XML file into the Teamcenter database.
Supported key-value pairs are:
    • "scope": The scope value is used to import the table configurations for that scope. Possible values are: "Site", "Group", "Role", or "Workspace".
    • "scopeName": The name of the valid Teamcenter scope. When "scope" is "Site", this value is empty. When "scope"" is "Group", "Role", or "Workspace", this value is the name of a valid Teamcenter Group, Role, or Workspace.
    • "action": Supported values are override, merge and skip. When it is empty, override is taken as default. When action is override, any table configuration that is being imported, if it already exists in the database, will be overwritten with the contents from the XML. When action is merge, any table configuration that is being imported, if it already exists in the database, the contents will be merged with the contents from the XML. When action is skip, any table configuration that is being imported, if it already exists in the database, the import will be skipped for that table configuration.

Struct.description:
This structure contains the “work-area” selection objects on which command visibility has to be evaluated.

Work-area selection
The Active Workspace Client “work-area” section implementation is a scalable selection mechanism and supports any number of work-areas. However, the current AW implementation only allows for two “work-area” selections: Primary and Secondary. The Primary “work-area” is displayed as the leftmost view, which can be shown as a List, Table, or Tree view. The Secondary “work-area”, also known as "with Summary," is displayed as the rightmost view.

Primary work-area selection:
The first SelectionInfo2 object added to the GetVisibleCommands2Input.selectionInfo list consists of one or multiple objects in its selectedObjects list. The value of parentSelectionIndex is required to be '1' which is the index of the second SelectionInfo2 object added to the GetVisibleCommands2Input.selectionInfo list.

The second SelectionInfo2 object added to the GetVisibleCommands2Input.selectionInfo list must contain the topmost "common" parent node of all the objects in the first SelectionInfo2 object in its selectedObjects list. If the top nodes share a common node branch, then the parent node of this branch is added to its selectedObjects list. If the top nodes are the top visible nodes in the Primary “work-area”, then the invisible Root Node is to be used. The selectedObjects list can only contain one object; having more than one object is considered undefined behavior. The value of parentSelectionIndex is required to be '-1' (any other value is considered undefined behavior).

Primary with secondary work-area selection:
This selection use-case is only available when there is a "single" selection in the Primary “work-area”. In a multi-selection, the Secondary “work-area” is not available.

The first SelectionInfo2 object added to the GetVisibleCommands2Input.selectionInfo list consists of one or multiple objects from the Secondary “work-area” in its selectedObjects list. The value of parentSelectionIndex is required to be '1' which is the index of the second SelectionInfo2 object added to the GetVisibleCommands2Input.selectionInfo list.

The second SelectionInfo2 object added to the GetVisibleCommands2Input.selectionInfo list consists of the "single" selection object from the Primary “work-area” in its selectedObjects list. Adding an object from the Secondary “work-area” or having more than one object is considered undefined behavior. The value of parentSelectionIndex is required to be '-1' (any other value is considered undefined behavior).
Struct.name: SelectionInfo2

OperationTemplate.description:
The operation queries on scratch, accountability and subscription tables to identify the impacted ItemRevisions from last index time due to adds/modify/deletes that took place. These impacted objects need to be re-indexed to have the revision rule selectors updated.
Steps:
1.    Queries for deleted objects from scratch table. Gets their parent Item objects from accountability table impacted island if they exist. For the Item objects found, it fetches all the ItemRevisions and adds them to the response.
2.    Queries for newly added objects from scratch table. Filters out non ItemRevisions from the list. Adds the ItemRevisions to the reponse.
3.    Queries for any Modified islands from the accountability table. If modified island belongs to an ItemRevision, then the ItemRevision will be added to the response.

Finally the response will contain the impacted ItemRevisions due to adds/modify/deletes.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::FullTextSearch::getImpactedItemRevsForReIndex
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The list of impacted ItemRevision UIDs. The following partial errors may be returned:

    • 141051:     The operation to retrieve the impacted ItemRevision objects for synchronization has failed. Please refer to the Teamcenter server syslog file for more information.

This operation is invoked to query the data for a property having an LOV attachment. The results returned from the server also take into consideration any filter string that is in the input. This operation returns both LOV meta data as necessary for the client to render the LOV and partial LOV values list as specified.
The operation will return the results in the LOVSearchResults data structure. Maximum number of results to be returned are specified in the InitialLOVData data structure. If there are more results, the moreValuesExist flag in the LOVSearchResults data structure will be true. If the flag is true, more values can be retrieved with a call to the getNextLOVValues operation.

It also contains the instance data (LOV values) that the client can use to render the LOV UI widget. The output also contains information as to whether there are more results to be processed in which case a user can page to get next set of values (this triggers a call to the getNextLOVValues operation). The following partial errors are returned in the ServiceData - 54051 - The property is not a valid sort property. Property must be one of the LOV Value or LOV Description or any of Filter Properties. - 54052 - The Dynamic LOV has an invalid configuration. It may be that Business Object Type this dynamic LOV may not exists in the system. Please contact your business modeler administrator with this information - 54053- The Dynamic LOV has an invalid configuration with one of the filter property does not exists. Please contact your business modeler administrator with this information - 54054- The Dynamic LOV has an invalid configuration The specified LOV value property for the Dynamic LOV does not exists. Please contact your business modeler administrator with this - 54055- The Dynamic LOV has an invalid configuration. The specified LOV value description property for the Dynamic LOV does not exists. Please contact your business modeler administrator with this information

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation searches for active GroupMember based on name, role and group inputs . Literal and partial strings (strings with wildcard character '*') are supported. Literal string are AND together and partial strings are grouped OR and AND with with the literal strings.
Using the following search critera:

userId = "tc*"
userName = "tcadmin"
groupName = "dba"
roleName = "DB*"

The operation will assemble the final search criteria as follows:

username = "tcadmin" AND groupName = "dba" AND ( userId = "tc*" OR roleName = "DB*" ).

Following examples demonstrate how this operation can be used to get GroupMember objects based on different inputs:

    • Search for GroupMember objects which have User objects where userd_id, user_name contain "XYZ". Input for this search will be :

userId - "*XYZ*"
userName - "*XYZ*"

    • Search for GroupMember objects which have User or Role or Group objects where userd_id, user_name, role_name,or name contain "xyz". Input for this search will be :

userId - "*xyz*"
userName - "*xyz*"
roleName - "*xyz*"
groupName - "*xyz*"

    • Search for GroupMember objects which have User or Role objects where userd_id,user_name, role_name contain "xyz" and has Group object with name "dba". Inputs for this search will be :

userId - "*xyz*"
userName - "*xyz*"
roleName - "*xyz*"
groupName - "dba"

    • Search for GroupMember objects which have User or Group objects where userd_id, user_name, name contain "xyz" and has Role object with role_name "DBA". Inputs for this search will be :

userId - "*xyz*"
userName - "*xyz*"
roleName - "DBA"
groupName - "*xyz*"

    • Search for GroupMember objects which have User objects where user_id, user_name contain"xyz" and Role object with role_name "DBA" and Group object with name "dba". Inputs for this search will be :

userId - "*xyz*"
userName - "*xyz*"
roleName - "DBA"
groupName - "dba"

    • Search for GroupMember objects which have User objects where user_id "xyz" and user_name "xyz" and Role object with role_name "DBA" and Group object with name "dba". Inputs for this search will be :

userId - "xyz"
userName - "xyz"
roleName - "DBA"
groupName - "dba"
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::OrganizationManagement::getGroupMembership2
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A list of GroupMember objects found after performing the GroupMember objects search. This operation also returns the map of User object to Person objects . The User objects returned in the map are corresponding to the found GroupMember objects.
Possible errors returned in ServiceData are:

516001 - An enquiry internal error has occurred..
516127 - The enquiry module has run out of memory.
516130 - The enquiry has timed-out.

OperationParameter.description: The input search criteria for finding the GroupMember objects.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation lists the business objects whose READ access is impacted by the changes in Access Manager rule tree. The rule tree changes considered are limited to those made after the previous call to this operation.
This operation is usually called periodically and the objects whose read access is modified due to the changes to Access Manager rule tree between the previous call and the current one are determined and returned.
Optionally, this operation returns the set of objects which is the intersection of objects impacted by Access Manager rule changes and objects previously indexed. Previously indexed objects are stored in ACCT_TABLE table. The application id will be used to further filter the objects impacted by Access manager rule changes and got previously indexed for a particular application.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::FullTextSearch::getAMImpactedObjects
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
An instance of GetAMImpactedObjectsResponse with the list of objects whose read access is modified. If the number of objects impacted is too large the flag isImpactGlobal is set to true and the callers may treat this as the indication to perform full reindexing. Number of objects returned in this case will be zero. Number of objects returned can also be zero when there are no changes to the rule tree. In this case the isImpactGlobal flag will be returned as false.
The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 525185     Failed to identify impacted objects.

OperationParameter.description: Application ID subscribed by Access Manager to identify the impacted objects by rule tree changes. Ex: ":FTS_AMSYNC"
OperationParameter.name: amSyncAppID

OperationParameter.description: The unique identifier to differentiate objects indexed to different target applications. This is optional. If this is specified only the objects previosuly indexed by this application and impacted due to rule tree changes will be returned. Else all the impacted objects from the entire database will be included in the response. Ex: ":FTS_SYNC" is the application ID used for indexing object data.
OperationParameter.name: applicationID

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation returns the dataset type and reference information for a set of file extensions. This operation also returns the default paste relation for each Dataset type returned for the given input parent. Named references are Teamcenter objects that related to a specific data file.

For each file extension, it is possible that it belongs to multiple dataset types. For such cases, all matching dataset types will be returned using the file extension as the key in the GetDatasetTypesWithDefaultRelationOutput structure.

The order of file extension in the GetDatasetTypesWithDefaultRelationOutput structure may be different than the order of file extension input. This operation inserts file extensions that match the default dataset type defined in AE_default_dataset_type preference at the beginning of the list.

This operation uses the TC_Dataset_Import_Exclude_Wildcard preference to determine if wildcard may be used in file extension input. If the preference is set and file extension is set to asterisk, this operation will return all data set types that allow wildcards in its name reference in Teamcenter.

Default paste relation for each Dataset type returned is determined by evaluating preferences __default_relation and/or _default_relation. The preference __default_relation takes precedence over _default_relation.

Details about these four preferences can be found in Preferences and Environment (Variables Reference Configuration preferences, under Data management preferences).
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::DataManagement::getDatasetTypesWithDefaultRelation
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Dataset type and reference information for each fileExtensions input and default paste relation for each Dataset type for the given input parent.
The following partial errors may be returned:
214135 :The input file extension does not exist.

OperationParameter.description: Parent object which acts as primary for the Dataset. If parent object is null or invalid then default relation is not populated with the response.
OperationParameter.name: parent

OperationParameter.description: List of file extensions used to get the named reference information, such as "doc" or "txt".
OperationParameter.name: fileExtensions
