If a client needs to reset the column information for login user scope, they can use this operation. The new effective UI column configuration will be retrieved for the login user.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of input information required to retrieve UI column configurations from the Teamcenter database.

Operation.description: This service operation fetches all of the table configurations in the Teamcenter database. The administrator can view each one in Active Workspace client.
Operation.name: getTableConfigurations
Operation.returnDescription:
The JSON string containing the table configurations information.

Supported schema:
"[
    {
        tableConfigId: "ExampleTableConfigId",
        parentTableConfigId: "ExampleParentTableConfigId",
        displayName: "ExampleDisplayName"
        tableConfigType: "ExampleConfigurationType",
        tableConfigTypeDisplayName: "Example Configuration Type",
        hasChildren: true
    }
]"
Operation.useCase: The administrator navigates to the "Table Configurator" application in Active Workspace client. This service operation will be invoked so that the administrator can view each table configuration applicable to Active Workspace client.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of filters (FilterCriteriaInput) to narrow down the search results.

The options for searching for the table configurations. Supported key-value pairs are:
    • "sortDirection" - The sort direction, either "ASC" or "DESC".
    • "focusTableConfigUri" - The uri of a table configuration to focus. Ex: "Awp0ObjectNavigation"
    • "tableConfigId" - The identifier of the table configuration for which to fetch overrides. Ex: "ExampleTableConfigId".

Operation.description: This operation supplies the client with the list of commands in each command bar based on the selection, command context, and the current client scope.
Operation.name: getVisibleCommands2
Operation.returnDescription:
A list of commands that are visible in each command bar based on the input provided to the operation. The following partial errors may be returned:
302010 - Invalid Client Scope. The client scope URI is not defined for the client.
302012 - Invalid Client. The name of a client application is not valid. This value is represented by an instance of Awp0Client in the Teamcenter database and must match a value of the Awp0ClientName property.
302013 - Invalid Scope. Scope parameter input value is not valid. Valid values are Site, Group, Role, User, LoginUser and AvailableForLoginUser.
302014 - Invalid Hosting Client. The name of a hosting client application is not valid. This value is represented by an instance of Awp0Client in the Teamcenter databases and must match a value of the Awp0ClientName property.
Operation.useCase:
It gets command visibility in each command bar.
A user wants to know which command buttons are visible in each command bar in AWClient for a given selection, command context, and client scope. This information is used to determine the visibility of each command's button in the respective command bar.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of input information required to determine the visibility of command in each command bar.

Operation.description: This service operation imports the table configurations XML into the Teamcenter database. Active workspace client will use this information to display the tables in various applications.
Operation.name: importTableConfigurations
Operation.returnDescription: This service operation returns the ServiceData object.
Operation.useCase: The administrator navigates to the "Table Configurator" application in Active Workspace client. The administrator will click on the import command that launches a panel which asks for input table configurations XML File and scope information and then click on import button from the import panel. Client will use this imported XML information to show table columns in various applications.

ParameterInfo.description: Input Structure Containing the information to import the table configurations into the database.

Operation.description: This service operation will load the given named column configuration for a given user.
Operation.name: loadNamedColumnConfig
Operation.returnDescription:
The JSON string containing the named column configurations information.

Example:
"{
        columnConfigName: 'LoadExampleName',
        uid: 'LoadExampleUid',
        isAdmin: true,
        isModifiable: false,
        isCurrent: true,
        columnConfig: {
            columnConfigId: 'LoadExampleId',
            operationType: 'Intersection',
            columns: [
                {
                    displayName: 'Name',
                    typeName: 'WorkspaceObject',
                    propertyName: 'object_name',
                    pixelWidth: 120,
                    columnOrder: 0,
                    hiddenFlag: false,
                    sortPriority: 1,
                    sortDirection: 'Ascending',
                    filterValue: {
                        operation: '',
                        values: []
                    },
                    filterDefinitionKey: '',
                    isFilteringEnabled: true,
                    dataType: 'String',
                    isFrozen: true
                }
            ]
        }
}"

Also, the ServiceData structure containing any partial errors that may have occurred while getting the data in the input structures. The following partial errors may be returned:
•302001 - Invalid column configuration id.
•302010 - Invalid Client Scope URI.
Operation.useCase:
Load a Named Column Configuration:
This service operation will be called which will get the detailed columns information from the selected named column configuration.

ParameterInfo.description: The uid of the named column configuration object to load.

Operation.description: This service operation saves the named column configuration information to the Teamcenter database. Active Workspace client may use this information to populate columns of tables in various sublocations as the user navigates.
Operation.name: saveNamedColumnConfig3
Operation.returnDescription:
The ServiceData structure containing any partial errors that may have occurred while managing the named column configurations. The following partial errors may be returned:
•302001 - Invalid column configuration id.
•302003 - Invalid object type name.
•302004 - Invalid property name.
•302005 - Invalid pixel width.
•302010 - Invalid Client Scope URI.
Operation.useCase:
Save Named Column Configuration:
A user wants to modify an existing named column configuration for a given table by adding or removing columns. The modified named column configuration will become the active column configuration for that user.

ParameterInfo.description: The uid of the named column configuration object to save.
A list of column configuration data including information about each column to be created or saved.

A map (string, string) of options for managing the named column configuration. Supported key-value pairs are:
    • “Group” - “Engineering”. When “Group” option is used, the named column configuration will be created or saved for that particular group, which is “Engineering” group in this case. Other group names are also valid values of the “Group” option.
    • “operationType” - “Union” or “Intersection”. When “operationType” option is used with “Union” value, the union of the columns associated with the named column configuration are returned. When “operationType” option is used with “Intersection” value, the intersection of the columns associated with the named column configuration are returned.

Operation.description: This operation creates, updates or deletes the input personalization data.
Operation.name: saveOrDeletePersonalizationData
Operation.returnDescription:
Partial errors are returned in the Service Data. The following partial errors may be returned:
302471 – Personalization data with Id <Id name> does not exist.
302472 - The scope <Scope name> provided to create the personalization data is not supported.
Operation.useCase:
1.    User pins a command to application chooser, personalization data for the pinned command is created.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of PersonalizationData structures which provides input information for saving the personalization data, if the personalization data with the given Id exists, it is updated, otherwise a new Awp0P13nData personalization data object is created.
A list of PersonalizationData structures which provides input information for deleting the personalization data.

Operation.useCase:
1.    User pins a command to application chooser, personalization data for the pinned command is created.

Operation.description: This service operation saves table configuration information to the Teamcenter database. Active Workspace client will use this information to populate columns of tables in various applications.
Operation.name: saveTableConfiguration2
Operation.returnDescription:
The columns that were successfully saved are returned. Also, the ServiceData structure containing any partial errors that may have occurred while saving the table configuration. The follow partial errors may be returned:
    • 302003 - Invalid object type name.
    • 302004 - Invalid property name.
    • 302005 - Invalid pixel width.
Operation.useCase:
An administrator edits a table configuration:
The administrator views a table configuration, edits the width of a column and clicks the "Save" button. This service operation will be invoked with the updated width of the column and will be saved in the Teamcenter database. Any user that is using that table configuration will be able to see the updated width of the column in Active Workspace client.

ParameterInfo.description: The identifier of the table configuration to save.
A list of column configuration data including information about each column to be created or saved.
A map (string, string) containing the options for saving a table configuration. This is reserved for future use.

Operation.description: This service operation saves column configuration information to the Teamcenter database. A Teamcenter client may use this information to render the user interface as the user navigates the Teamcenter client. Default column configurations are initially created by a utility during install. This operation will modify the default column configuration for the site, group, role or a specific user.
Operation.name: saveUIColumnConfigs3
Operation.returnDescription:
The ServiceData structure containing any partial errors that may have occurred while saving the data in the input structures. The following partial errors may be returned:
•302001 - Invalid column configuration id.
•302003 - Invalid object type name.
•302004 - Invalid property name.
•302005 - Invalid pixel width.
•302010 - Invalid Client Scope URI.
Operation.useCase:
User level column configuration:
A User wants to change the default column configuration for a Client Scope when he is logged into the client. The saved configuration will override the default configuration for the user's applicable role, group or site.

ParameterInfo.description: List of column configurations.

OperationTemplate.description: Returns the accountability tables' and the related POM tables' diagnostic information. The accountability tables are used for recording exported data and statuses, as well as data synchronization status and candidates.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::TCXML::getDiagnosticInfoForAcctTables
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
For the input information type value 1:
TableDiagnosticInfo
The table name: SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE
The list of NameValuesInfo structures has two NameValuesInfo:
NameValuesInfo1:
The table information type: SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE content
The list of table information values:
app_id1, lpd1
app_id2, lpd2
......
NameValuesInfo2:
The table information type: SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE stale app_id(s)
The list of table information values:
app_id3, lpd3
app_id7, lpd7
......
For the input information type value 2:
TableDiagnosticInfo
The table name: SCRATCH_TABLE
The list of NameValuesInfo structures has two NameValuesInfo:
NameValuesInfo1:
The table information type: SCRATCH_TABLE trigger_condition summary
The list of table information values:
trigger_condition=8, count=xxx
trigger_condition=9, count=xxx
......
NameValuesInfo2:
The table information type: SCRATCH_TABLE NULL lsd count
The list of table information values:
count=xxx
For the input information type value 4:
TableDiagnosticInfo
The table name: SCRATCH_TABLE
The list of NameValuesInfo structures has one NameValuesInfo:
The table information type: SCRATCH_TABLE class summary
The list of table information values:
class1, count=xxx
class2, count=xxx
......
For the input information type value 8:
TableDiagnosticInfo
The table name: ACCT_TABLE
The list of NameValuesInfo structures has one NameValuesInfo:
The table information type: ACCT_TABLE state summary
The list of table information values:
state=1, count=xxx
state=2, count=xxx
......
For the input information type value 16:
TableDiagnosticInfo
The table name: POM_object
The list of NameValuesInfo structures has one NameValuesInfo:
The table information type: POM_object trigger status
The list of table information values:
add trigger, ok/missing
delete trigger, ok/missing

The following partial error may be returned:
515209: The operation failed due to an unexpected Database Management System error.
11001: TIE internal error.

OperationParameter.description:
Specifies the table information types to be retrieved. The valid values are one or sum of multiple values below:
0: Includes all the supported information types listed below.
1: SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE information. The whole table content and the stale app_id(s) will be returned. The SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE records all the applications' last processing time that is used for synchronizing data. If an app_id's lpd is within the threshold defined by DB parameter TC_TIMESTAMP_THRESHOLD, POM_TIMESTAMP table is used for data synchronization. Otherwise POM_object table is used for data synchronization, and the app_id is called stale app_id.
2: SCRATCH_TABLE summary information. The table rows count for different trigger_condition column values and the rows count for NULL lsd cloumn value will be returned. The SCRATCH_TABLE records synchronization data candidates.
4: SCRATCH_TABLE class information. The table rows count for the top 20 classes will be returned.
8: ACCT_TABLE summary information. The table rows count for different state column values will be returned. The ACCT_TABLE records all the exported data and statuses.
16: Database triggers information. The database triggers are on POM_object table for supporting data synchronization. The status of the add and delete triggers will be returned.
OperationParameter.name: infoType

OperationTemplate.description: Installs Database triggers on POM_object table for tracking newly added objects and (or) deleted objects that are used for data synchronization purpose.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::AWS2::TCXML::installDBTriggersForDataSync
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The following partial error may be returned:
515209: The operation failed due to an unexpected Database Management System error.

OperationParameter.description:
Specifies the Database trigger type that will be installed. The valid values are:
1: The database trigger for tracking the newly added objects in POM_object table which stores all Teamcenter persistent objects.
2: The database trigger for tracking the deleted objects in POM_object table which stores all Teamcenter persistent objects.
3: The database triggers for tracking both the newly added objects and the deleted objects in POM_object table which stores all Teamcenter persistent objects.
OperationParameter.name: triggerType

StructElement.description:
A map (string, list of strings) represents the different properties of the task with type name. This input specify the properties of the task to be outputted to JSON string.
If a client wants to get a property value of an object which can be traversed using a reference property on a given input task then following format need to be used :
REF( reference_property_name, reference_object_type ).property_on_reference_object

For example : If the client wants to get object_string of workflow process (EPMJob), then it has to provide the input data in following format :
"EPMTask", "REF(parent_process,EPMJob).object_string"}

In above example :
reference_property_name is the “parent_process” reference property defined on EPMTask.
reference_object_type is the “EPMJob” referenced by the “parent_process” property on EPMTask.
property_on_reference_object is the “object_string”. property on EPMJob.

Below are the few examples of this input:
To get task properties: "EPMTask", {"state_value", "signoff_quorum"}
To get task reference property :"EPMTask", {"REF(parent_process,EPMJob).object_string"}
To get task signoff data : "Signoff", {"REF(group_member,GroupMember).group", "REF(group_member,GroupMember).user", "fnd0DecisionRequired" }
To get task signoff profile data : "EPMSignoffProfile",{"REF(group,Group).name", "REF(role,Role).role_name", "number_of_signoffs"}
StructElement.name: typeToPropertiesMap

Operation.useCase:
In Active Workspace, Select-Signoff-Task perform panel needs to show the following data:
    • Required Profiles with the count of unstaffed profiles
    • Profile signoffs
    • Adhoc signoffs
    • Quorum data

This SOA is designed to get all the above data . It can also return a logical flag(s) to indicate if the task can be completed or not based on which complete button can be displayed in the dialog.This will avoid unnecessory complex logic on the client to segregate data( like profiles, profile signoffs and adhoc signoff) to display in the panel and to detemine current quorum based on exisiting signoffs etc.

Operation.useCase:
Use this operation to search for tasks in logged in user's inbox. User can provide multiple search criteria to search for tasks. For example :

Search tasks by specific task type
User wants to search for all the Do tasks in his inbox.

Search tasks by assignee
User wants to search for all the task in his inbox which are assigned to a specific group.

Search tasks by due date
User wants to search for all the tasks in his inbox based on a due date. The due date can be specified as a specific date or month or year.

ParameterInfo.description: The input search criteria for finding the tasks.

TcGlobalConstant.description:
false - This is the default value. A full reindex is required to rescind all previously indexed attribute-level security (ALS) properties and remove them from the search index. ALS properties will not be included in future indexing operations.
true - Set true to index ALS properties. Please note that indexing ALS properties allows users to search on these properties. The search results will suppress the display of the property if the user is restricted from reading the property. It is recommended that you review your company's data security policies before enabling this option.
TcGlobalConstant.name: Awp0AllowSearchOnALSEnabledProperties

TcGlobalConstant.name: Awp0IndexCompoundPropertySourceLovDisplayValue

TcGlobalConstant.description: Global Constant to determine whether to index object data properties which are marked as localizable in BMIDE.
TcGlobalConstant.name: Awp0IndexLocalizedValues

TcGlobalConstant.description: Global constant which when turned on stores all the fields marked for indexing. This needs to be set to True inorder to support Atmoic updates while synchronizing indexed data.

TcGlobalConstant.name: Awp0StoreDatasetContent

TcTypeConstant.description: Used to identify the Dataset to be indexed along with the Business Object. The value should be like <INHERIT/NO_INHERIT>:<RelationName>:<DatasetType>. Supports multiple dataset types for a single relation. Dataset types are to be separated by tilde character '~'. The value can be a comma separated list of the mentioned format.
TcTypeConstant.name: Awp0DatasetTypeToBeIndexedInline

TcTypeConstant.description: This constant defines the behavior of inline indexing of dataset contents. Possible values are Inline and Relation. In case of 'Inline', dataset content are indexed inline of the parent business object. So any time search operation matches the dataset content, associated parent business objects are returned. And in case of 'Relation', dataset content are indexed as part of the dataset itself. However, the indexed dataset maintains a reference to the parent business object. During search, when dataset is returned it also brings in the parent business object.
TcTypeConstant.name: Awp0SearchDatasetIndexingBehavior

TcPropertyConstant.description: Indicates whether the property should be embedded for metadata purposes.

Struct.description:
Structure defines the mode, the UID of the input Awp0SearchFolder object and the transient file ticket for the TCXML file specified in the Active Workspace client for the importSearchFolder service operation.
The mode parameter has two valid values, preview and import. The preview mode is a way for the user to see what structure is going to be imported into the input Awp0SearchFolder object. The import mode is when the user wants to do the TCXML import of the Awp0SearchFolder hierarchy along with its ReportDefinition and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule which is specified in the TCXML into the input Awp0SearchFolder object.
The searchFolderUID specifies the UID of the input active folder under which the hierarchy is to be imported.
If it is passed as empty, then the import will happen into the Awp0MySearchFolder instance of the logged in user.
Struct.name: ImportInput

StructElement.description:
Specifies whether to get the preview of the Awp0SearchFolder with its hierarchy or to import the Awp0SearchFolder and its hierarchy. Valid values are: “import” and “preview”.
Import: Used to import the Awp0SearchFolder object, its children, and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule and ReportDefinition objects attached to it as a child of the searchFolderUID.
Preview: Provides the preview of the root Awp0SearchFolder object specified in the TCXML along with its hierarchy (its children) in tree view mode in a JSON string format.
StructElement.name: mode

StructElement.description: The file ticket for the TCXML to be imported into the selected Awp0SearchFolder. (required)
StructElement.name: transientFileTicket

StructElement.description: UID of the input Awp0SearchFolder under which the contents of the TCXML needs to be imported. Required for import mode; otherwise, it is empty.
StructElement.name: searchFolderUID

Struct.description:
The response contains the serviceData and the preview string in JSON format. The serviceData contains any partial errors returned from the import operation using TIE import and the preview of the hierarchy of the Awp0SearchFolder object specified in the input TCXML file. Hierarchy meaning it will mention the name of the root Awp0SearchFolder and the names of its children active folders till the leaf Awp0SearchFolder object. The previewStringJSON will be only returned if the input mode parameter is passed as preview. Otherwise for the import mode, it will be empty.

Structure of JSON schema:

"dataForTheTree":
[
    {
     "label": "Active Folder 001",
     "children":
     [
     {
     "label": "Active Folder 001-Child",
     "children":
     [
     {
"label": "Active Folder Sub Child",
     "children":[]
     }
     ]
     },
     {
     "label": "Active Folder 002-Child"
     }
     ]
    }
]
Struct.name: ImportSearchFolderResponse

StructElement.description: Service data for holding the partial errors returned for the import of the transient file ticket or preview of the TCXML file to be imported.
StructElement.name: serviceData

StructElement.description: A preview of the hierarchy of the Awp0SearchFolder specified in the TCXML. Output is in JSON format which the client will read to show the hierarchy in tree view mode. Only returned when the mode is preview. Empty for the import mode.
StructElement.name: previewStringJSON

Typedef.description:
Map (string, list of strings) of Awp0SearchFolder attribute names and their values.
The following attributes can be set when a Awp0SearchFolder is created or edited.
Name,
Description,
Shared with User,
Shared with Role,
Shared with Group,
Shared with Project.
                        
Example:     
Creation Case:
When “Active Folder1” is created and shared with Group1, Group2 and with Project1, entries of this map are going to be following:
Name    {Specification Search}
Description         {All active
            specifications}
Shared with Group     {Group1UID, Group2UID}
Shared with Project     {Project1UID}

An Active Folder with name “Specification Search” and description “All active specifications” is created and shared with Group1, Group2 and Project1.

Edit Case:
If “Specification Search” folder needs to be shared with User1 and User2, now entries of this map are going to be following:
Shared with User    {User1UID, User2UID}
Now Active Folder is also shared with User1 and User2.
Typedef.name: SearchFolderAttributes

OperationTemplate.description: Creates or edits one or more Awp0SearchFolder objects. An Awp0SearchFolder object is a subtype of Folder with an integrated search definition. It displays dynamic contents based on the search definition it contains. Internally, Awp0SearchFolder' s search definition is represented by a ReportDefinition object. This operation supports creation and modification of Awp0SearchFolder's with necessary inputs.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::SearchFolder::createOrEditSearchFolders
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The created or edited Search Folders along with their attribute details.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141371 The input search folder uid is invalid.
141372 The search folder object could not be created. Please contact your system administrator.
141373 The search folder object could not be edited. Please contact your system administrator.
141374 The search folder object uid is empty. Please contact your system administrator.
141375 The logged in user does not have write access on the Awp0SearchFolder business object.
141376 The projects list do not have valid UIDs.
141377 The accessors list do not have valid UIDs.
141378 The parent under which Search Folder is expected to be created is not a instance of Awp0SearchFolder or Folder Business Object.

OperationParameter.description: A list of Awp0SearchFolder inputs in order to create or modify them.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description: Exports one or more Awp0SearchFolder objects and its hierarchy. Every valid instance of Awp0SearchFolder is exported with its associated ReportDefinition and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::SearchFolder::exportSearchFolders
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The transient file tickets of exported files.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141371 The input active folder UID is invalid.
141388 The type of the input UID is expected to be an instance of Awp0SearchFolder.

Throws:
None

OperationParameter.description: A List of Awp0SearchFolder UIDs to be exported.
OperationParameter.name: searchFolderUIDs

OperationTemplate.description: Returns list of accessors for each of the provided Awp0SearchFolder instance. An Awp0SearchFolder can be shared with different organizational entities like users, groups, roles. The list of accessors represent these entities with whom the folder has been shared.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::SearchFolder::getSearchFolderAccessors
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Returns Awp0SearchFolder and their accessors list.
The following partial error may be returned:
141371 The input active folder UID is invalid.

OperationParameter.description: A list of Awp0SearchFolder UIDs. Operation expects only valid instances of Awp0SearchFolder type as input.
OperationParameter.name: searchFolders

OperationTemplate.description: Imports a TCXML file containing Awp0SearchFolder object with its hierarchy and its associated ReportDefinition and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule objects.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::SearchFolder::importSearchFolder
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The preview of the Awp0SearchFolder object specified in the input TCXML.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141411 - Unable to import object “<Object name>” with UID “<UID>”. Please contact your system administrator.
141412 - Unable to show the preview for the Active Folder and its hierarchy. Please contact your system administrator.
141413 – Invalid mode specified in the input. Valid values are “import” and “preview”.

Throws:
None

OperationParameter.description: Input structure for the import of the Awp0SearchFolder and its hierarchy along with the associated ReportDefinition object and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule object specified in the input TCXML.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description: Generates target data source compatible search recipe and parameters for a given list of Teamcenter ReportDefinition objects. The returned search recipes can be directly consumed by external data sources, like Solr, without additional help from Teamcenter. A ReportDefinition object holds platform independent search recipe. When this object is opened or executed from within Teamcenter applications, the recipe is first translated to work with the target data source and then necessary search actions are performed. This operation provides translated search parameters to the caller so that search actions associated with Reports can be done outside of Teamcenter.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::SearchFolder::getTranslatedReportSearchRecipe
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: Information about a group of ReportDefinition objects, their translated search recipes, and search recipes that are common for the current session.

OperationParameter.description: An array of criteria objects to identify Teamcenter ReportDefinition objects.
OperationParameter.name: reportDefinitionCriteria

OperationTemplate.description: This operation finds files associated with a given list of Datasets and filters out those which are not supported for indexing. Optionally, reference names can be specified to further restrict the returned files. Finally, returns a map of Dataset UIDs and information on supported files including UID and FMS ticket for file download.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::Indexer::getDatasetIndexableFilesInfo
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A map (string, DatasetInfo) of Dataset UIDs and objects containing information on their associated, indexable files.
The following partial errors may be returned by the operation:
141116 The unique identifier (datasetUIDs) provided for Dataset is invalid.

OperationParameter.description: A list of unique identifiers of the Dataset objects for which file ticket information is needed for indexing.
OperationParameter.name: datasetUIDs

OperationParameter.description: A list of reference names to be used to restrict the returned files. If no value is specified, information on all indexable files will be fetched. For example, if UGPART is specified, only the file associated with this reference name will be included in the response.
OperationParameter.name: referenceNames

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation queries for the indexed WorkspaceObject objects matching the given input criteria. Criteria include application ID, and AM sync subscription ID. Query is executed on AM_IMPACTED table joining with ACCT_TABLE     to identify the indexed data that got impacted by AM Rule changes. The data is staged in OBJDATA_INDEXER_BUFFER_TABLE with a Batch ID. The Batch ID and the counts are returned.

This operation is dependent on the following non-POM Teamcenter database tables.
SCRATCH_TABLE : Keeps track of all newly created and deleted Teamcenter objects.
ACCT_TABLE : Keeps track of all objects exported by Teamcenter along with their status.
AM_IMPACTED : Keeps track of all Teamcenter objects that are impacted by Access Manager (AM) rule tree changes.
SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE : Keeps track of applications registered to consume data from the SCRATCH_TABLE, ACCT_TABLE or AM_IMPACTED tables.
OBJDATA_INDEXER_BUFFER_TABLE : Keeps track of Teamcenter objects waiting to be indexed.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::Indexer::getAMImpactedObjectsBatchDetails
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The response structure containing the Batch IDs and Counts of AM Impacted Business Objects. The following partial errors may be returned.
• 515209 The operation failed due to an unexpected Database Management System error.

OperationParameter.description:
Application ID registered in the SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE to identify the AM impacted objects by rule tree changes.
Applications that need to consume the AM impacted data from AM_IMPACTED table should create their own unique application ID and register it in SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE. Currently Teamcenter Full Text Search Indexer application has ‘:FTS_AMSYNC’ as its application ID registered to identify AM impacted objects.
Example: ":FTS_AMSYNC"
OperationParameter.name: amSyncAppID

OperationParameter.description:
A unique identifier to differentiate objects indexed to different target applications. This is optional. If this is specified only the objects previously indexed by this application and impacted due to rule tree changes will be returned. Else all the impacted objects from the entire database will be included in the response.
Applications can create their own unique identifiers to track objects for synchronization queries and register them in the SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE. Example: TcFtsIndexer application has ‘:FTS_SYNC’ as its application ID to track indexed objects.
OperationParameter.name: applicationID

OperationTemplate.description: Determine the list of WorkspaceObject objects to index based on the given date and time range and the "Awp0SearchIsIndexed" business object constant. The objects found are staged in a buffer table (OBJDATA_INDEXER_BUFFER_TABLE) with a unique Batch ID. These Batch IDs and count of objects of the batch are returned as part of response. The caller is responsible to fetch the objects by Batch ID and process them.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::Indexer::getObjectsToIndexBatchDetails
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The response structure containing the Batch IDs and Counts of Indexable Business Objects. The following partial errors may be returned.
• 515209 The operation failed due to an unexpected Database Management System error.

OperationParameter.description: The input to determine the objects to index.
OperationParameter.name: objectsToIndexQryInput

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation queries for the indexed WorkspaceObject objects matching the given input criteria. Criteria include application ID, subscription ID, indexed timestamp, list of indexed statuses of the object and a list of object class names. The query gets executed on ACCT_TABLE to identify the data according to the application ID. The data returned by the query will be stored in OBJDATA_INDEXER_BUFFER_TABLE with a system generated unique Batch ID. The Batch ID and the counts will be returned.

This operation is dependent on the following non-POM Teamcenter database tables.
SCRATCH_TABLE : Keeps track of all newly created and deleted Teamcenter objects.
ACCT_TABLE : Keeps track of all objects exported by Teamcenter along with their status.
SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE : Keeps track of applications registered to consume data from the SCRATCH_TABLE, ACCT_TABLE or AM_IMPACTED tables.
OBJDATA_INDEXER_BUFFER_TABLE : Keeps track of Teamcenter objects waiting to be indexed.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::Search::Indexer::getObjectsToSyncBatchDetails
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The response structure containing the Batch IDs and counts of objects that needs to be indexed. The following partial errors may be returned.
• 515209 The operation failed due to an unexpected Database Management System error.

OperationParameter.description:
A unique identifier that identifies the application that indexed the object.
Applications that consume data from ACCT_TABLE create their own unique application IDs and register them in the SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE. ":FTS_SYNC" is the application ID of the Full Text Search Indexer that indexes object data.
OperationParameter.name: applicationID

OperationParameter.description:
The application id used to get the last processed date from SUBSCRIPTION TABLE to be used to filter the indexed objects. This is optional. If this value is specified it ignores the indexed date passed in as input to the operation.
Applications create different unique IDs to track objects for synchronization queries and register them in SUBSCRIPTION_TABLE. Currently Teamcenter Full Text Search Indexer application has ‘FTS_ADD_QRY’, ’FTS_DEL_QRY’ as unique IDs to perform queries and synchronize the indexed data.
Example:‘:FTS_ADD_QRY’, ‘:FTS_DEL_QRY’
OperationParameter.name: subscriptionAppID

OperationParameter.description: The timestamp used to identify objects that have been indexed before the specified date. If the value is NULLDATE, this field will be excluded from the query which means, all objects, regardless of when they were indexed, are returned if they match the other criteria.
OperationParameter.name: indexedDate

OperationParameter.description:
A list of statuses of the objects to be queried from the database table ACCT_TABLE. This is optional.
Supported values are
0 - status is ignored and not included as part of the query
1 - Replication Pending
2 - Replication Complete
3 - Dirty
4 - Import Failed
12 - Delta add pending
13 - Delta modify pending
14 - Delta delete pending
15 - Revision Rule refresh pending
16 - Add modify pending
17 - Modify relation pending
OperationParameter.name: statuses

OperationParameter.description:
A list of internal storage class names of the objects to find. This is optional and the list can be empty.
Example:
ItemRevision
DocumentRevision
CAEGeometryRevision
Requirement_0_Revision_alt
CommercialPart_0_Revis_alt0
Dataset
OperationParameter.name: classNames

Operation.description: This operation retrieves facet values in a paged fashion for a selected filter category. It also supports search on facet values to get matching facet values for a given text input. In addition it supports updating facet values based on column filters.
Operation.name: performFacetSearch
Operation.returnDescription:
The facet values for the selected search filter category based on the search results. The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 217016 Invalid search provider name. Either check the provider name or make sure the template containing the provider is installed.
    • 217017 Failed to perform search.
    • 140232 Invalid property name.
    • 140233 Invalid value for parameter maxToReturn. Only positive values are permissible.
Operation.useCase:
Use Case 1: The User clicks on unpopulated filter category
Only 200 classification filters are populated and available at the client. To get facet values for an unpopulated filter, a search request will be made by passing in the needed criteria. The search request queries for the facet values and returns to the client. The number of values to be returned is controlled by the input parameter maxToReturn.

Use Case 2: The User performs search for filter values by entering text in filter category search input box.
If the user types in a value in the filter box, a search request will be made by passing in the needed criteria. The input text will be passed into ‘stringValue’ parameter of the input searchFilterMap. The search request queries for the data and finds the facet values matching the input text. These facet values are included in the searchFilterMap of the response.

Use Case 3: The User clicks on “More” to get next set of facet values
If ‘hasMoreFacetValues’ flag of the FacetSearchResponse is true, the client will make a search request for facet values. Facet values will be queried and returned based on the input criteria.

Use Case 4: The User applies column filters in table view
If the user applies a column filter in table view, the client will make a search request to update facets applied with the column filters.

ParameterInfo.description: It contains search criteria, search filter and column filter information.

While executing the queries the data is staged in the buffer table (OBJDATA_INDEXER_BUFFER_TABLE). Indexer uses this SOA operation to fetch the data from this table in chunks that matches the given input criteria for further process of Export, Transform, Load (ETL).

ParameterInfo.description: Criteria to fetch the objects from the Buffer table.

Operation.useCase: First time indexing of data is done by querying data based on date and time range. Due to migration of data given date and time range can result in a high volume of data to be indexed. which causes performance issues for processing such huge numbers. To avoid such performance issues, the queried data is staged in a buffer table with a batch ID. The batch IDs are returned, and caller needs to fetch them per batch in chunks and process. This avoids the performance issue.

ParameterInfo.description: The input to determine the objects to index.

Operation.description: This operation updates the records in the buffer table that match the given input criteria with a status and processed date. Input criteria include batch ID, application ID, list of object UIDs.
Operation.name: updateObjectsIndexStatus
Operation.returnDescription:
The following partial errors may be returned:
•    515209     The operation failed due to an unexpected Database Management System error.
Operation.useCase:
Object Data Indexer Status Tracking
While indexing of data there might be issues during any step of the ETL (Extract, Transform and Load) process. Status should be updated to keep track of failed objects. This operation will be used to set the status for such objects. The status will help in identifying the failed objects for error recovery.

ParameterInfo.description: The unique string that identifies the batch of data stored in the table. This cannot be empty.

The unique identifier that identifies the application that fetched and stored the object in the buffer table. This cannot be empty.
Ex: ":FTS_SYNC" is the application ID of the Full Text Search
The list of object UIDs fetched and stored in the buffer table for indexing. (Optional)
The timestamp used to identify objects that have been indexed before the specified value. (Optional)

The indexing processed status of the object.
Valid values are positive integers.
1 = TIE_sync_status_replication_pending
2 = TIE_sync_status_replication_complete
4 = TIE_sync_status_import_failed
17 = TIE_sync_status_modify_rel_pending
18 = TIE_sync_status_add_pending
19 = TIE_sync_status_modify_pending
Processed Date to be updated. If the value is NULLDATE, the processed date field will not be updated.

The status to be updated for the matching records.
Valid values are positive integers.
1 = TIE_sync_status_replication_pending
2 = TIE_sync_status_replication_complete
4 = TIE_sync_status_import_failed
17 = TIE_sync_status_modify_rel_pending
18 = TIE_sync_status_add_pending
19 = TIE_sync_status_modify_pending

Operation.description: This operation creates or modifies a saved query with the given input. If a saved query with same name already exists it will modify the savedquery with the given input.
Operation.name: createOrModifySavedQuery
Operation.returnDescription:
Retuns the created or modified instance of the saved query.
Partial Errors are returned in the ServiceData . Following are possible errors returned:
    • 3001 Invalid class name.
    • 3024 No class was specified.
    • 3028 Cannot create a saved query.
    • 3038 Query name exists. Name must be unique.
Operation.useCase:
Use Case 1: The user inputs or the User provides the input with a query name which doesn't exist in the DB Resulting in the creation of a new ImanQuery if all parameters are valid.

Use Case 2: The user inputs or the User provides the input with a query name which already exists in the DB Resulting in the modification of the ImanQuery if all parameters are valid.

ParameterInfo.description: Structure to create or modify a savedquery.

Operation.description: Creates or edits one or more Awp0SearchFolder objects. An Awp0SearchFolder object is a subtype of Folder with an integrated search definition. It displays dynamic contents based on the search definition it contains. Internally, Awp0SearchFolder' s search definition is represented by a ReportDefinition object. This operation supports creation and modification of Awp0SearchFolder's with necessary inputs.
Operation.name: createOrEditSearchFolders
Operation.returnDescription:
The created or edited Search Folders along with their attribute details.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141371 The input search folder uid is invalid.
141372 The search folder object could not be created. Please contact your system administrator.
141373 The search folder object could not be edited. Please contact your system administrator.
141374 The search folder object uid is empty. Please contact your system administrator.
141375 The logged in user does not have write access on the Awp0SearchFolder business object.
141376 The projects list do not have valid UIDs.
141377 The accessors list do not have valid UIDs.
141378 The parent under which Search Folder is expected to be created is not a instance of Awp0SearchFolder or Folder Business Object.
Operation.useCase: Create Active Folders: User needs to create one or more instances of Awp0SearchFolder with their respective search definitions. Edit existing instances of Awp0SearchFolder: User needs to modify existing Active Folder instances. This can include updating the existing search definition or other Search Folder attributes like name or description.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of Awp0SearchFolder inputs in order to create or modify them.

Operation.description: This operation deletes a list of Active Folders provided in the input parameter.
Operation.name: deleteActiveFolders
Operation.returnDescription:
Returns ServiceData structure which holds the list of deleted Active Folders and partial errors if any.

Possible errors:
515001: User does not have the right to delete Active Folder referenced by the UID.
515024: The input UID is invalid.
Operation.useCase: Active Folders can be deleted in bulk. In order to do so, a user selects a group of Active Folders and follows that up with a call to this operation.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of Active Folder UIDs.

Operation.description: Exports one or more Awp0SearchFolder objects and its hierarchy. Every valid instance of Awp0SearchFolder is exported with its associated ReportDefinition and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule.
Operation.name: exportSearchFolders
Operation.returnDescription:
The transient file tickets of exported files.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141371 The input active folder UID is invalid.
141388 The type of the input UID is expected to be an instance of Awp0SearchFolder.

Throws:
None
Operation.useCase: 1. In Active Workspace, users will click on an Awp0SearchFolder object and on clicking the “Export Active Folder” command, an exported TCXML will be send back to the client through a transient file ticket in the service response, which the client uses to download the exported file.

ParameterInfo.description: A List of Awp0SearchFolder UIDs to be exported.

Operation.description: Returns list of accessors for each of the provided Awp0SearchFolder instance. An Awp0SearchFolder can be shared with different organizational entities like users, groups, roles. The list of accessors represent these entities with whom the folder has been shared.
Operation.name: getSearchFolderAccessors
Operation.returnDescription:
Returns Awp0SearchFolder and their accessors list.
The following partial error may be returned:
141371 The input active folder UID is invalid.
Operation.useCase: When a user selects an Awp0SearchFolder instance, the list of accessors having share access on the folder should also be displayed. Client will make a call to this operation to get the accessors list.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of Awp0SearchFolder UIDs. Operation expects only valid instances of Awp0SearchFolder type as input.

Operation.description: Generates target data source compatible search recipe and parameters for a given list of Teamcenter ReportDefinition objects. The returned search recipes can be directly consumed by external data sources, like Solr, without additional help from Teamcenter. A ReportDefinition object holds platform independent search recipe. When this object is opened or executed from within Teamcenter applications, the recipe is first translated to work with the target data source and then necessary search actions are performed. This operation provides translated search parameters to the caller so that search actions associated with Reports can be done outside of Teamcenter.
Operation.name: getTranslatedReportSearchRecipe
Operation.returnDescription: Information about a group of ReportDefinition objects, their translated search recipes, and search recipes that are common for the current session.
Operation.useCase:
Currently Teamcenter product data can be indexed in Apache Solr search engine as part of Active Workspace solution to facilitate full text search. The Active Workspace global search feature allows users to find and load Teamcenter objects indexed in Solr. To take further advantage of the indexed Teamcenter data in Solr, a microservice to generate charting information for a requested Teamcenter property has been introduced. The microservice expects a Solr compatible query to be sent as part of the request, along with the property for which charting information is desired. It then executes the query and sends back analytical information which the client can display as charts. Operation getTranslatedReportSearchRecipe provides the calling client information necessary to make a request to the microservice. 1. Client calls the getTranslatedReportSearchRecipe operation to obtain Solr compatible translated search parameters for a group of ReportDefinition objects.
2. Once the client obtains the necessary information, it makes asynchronous call to the microservice using the translated search parameters.
3. Microservice performs the necessary search action, puts together charting response for the requested ReportDefinition objects and sends it back to the client.
4. Client can then render the obtained data as charts.
Note: Since the whole search and chart generation process does not involve Teamcenter, live update of the Report objects can be done asynchronously and without blocking the client from executing any other actions.

ParameterInfo.description: An array of criteria objects to identify Teamcenter ReportDefinition objects.

Operation.description: Imports a TCXML file containing Awp0SearchFolder object with its hierarchy and its associated ReportDefinition and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule objects.
Operation.name: importSearchFolder
Operation.returnDescription:
The preview of the Awp0SearchFolder object specified in the input TCXML.
The following partial errors may be returned:
141411 - Unable to import object “<Object name>” with UID “<UID>”. Please contact your system administrator.
141412 - Unable to show the preview for the Active Folder and its hierarchy. Please contact your system administrator.
141413 – Invalid mode specified in the input. Valid values are “import” and “preview”.

Throws:
None
Operation.useCase:
Importing an Awp0SearchFolder hierarchy under an existing Awp0SearchFolder object

1. In Active Workspace client, user selects an existing Awp0SearchFolder object and clicks on the Import Active Folder command. A panel is displayed where the user can specify input TCXML file to import.

2. Once the user chooses a valid file, a preview of the Awp0SearchFolder hierarchy that is to be imported is rendered.

3. After the preview is complete, a button to import the file is displayed. When the user clicks on the import button, the folder hierarchy will be imported under the selected Awp0SearchFolder object.

Note: If an existing Awp0SearchFolder object is not selected during import, the hierarchy read from the input TCXML file will be created under the user’s Awp0MySearchFolder object.

ParameterInfo.description: Input structure for the import of the Awp0SearchFolder and its hierarchy along with the associated ReportDefinition object and Awp0SearchFolderShareRule object specified in the input TCXML.

u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0getPropValueOnRefObj(o,"awb0UnderlyingObject","is_modifiable")="true"

TcAttribute.description: The name of the group to which the tile belongs.Null value not allowed.
The Collection from which the tile was inherited.Null value not allowed.

The order in which the tiles are to be displayed within the group. Order number dictates the position of the tile within its group. The lowest order number in a group dictates the position of the group relative to other groups.Null value not allowed.
Is the Tile hidden? Valid values are true and false. This property is set when a user unpins an inherited tile from their gateway.
Size of tile. Valid values are 0, 1, 2, or 3 (small, tall, wide, or large).Null value not allowed.
The tile is protected. An admin can set this to prevent users from unpinning the Tile.
Describes if the tile is live. This property is for future use to designate content that dynamically updates.
Id of the tile. Keep unique by name-spacing with a solution prefix.This property should not be null.
String identifying css resource to use.
Reference to the Tile Template for the tile.This property should not be null.
The localizable display name of the tile.
Parameters to be supplied for tile action. These parameters are specific to the action specified on the template and get appended to the URL when the tile is clicked.
The string representation of the pinned object.
Reference to the scope of the collection. It can be a site/group/role or project.Null values are not allowed.
The tile represented by the proxy.Null is not allowed.
An ID that uniquely identifies a tile template. Should be name-spaced with a solution prefix.Null is not allowed.
The integer that indicates the theme for color of the Tile. Valid values are presented via a list. 0: light, 1 medium, 2: highlight, 3: alternate.

The Tile icon can be specified using this property or the awp0IconSource. This property specifies the base name of the Icon for the tile. Dark or light versions of the icon will be retrieved as needed. Base icon name + _dark or _light refers to the CSS class names. The css class defines the background-image property. Background-image points to a web tier file. Using a static image from web tier results in best performance. Ootb icons are defined in gateway.css and are combined into 1 image using sprites.
The action that needs to be performed by the Tile on click.

Sizes of the Tiles that this template supports. Can be used to limit available sizes for a tile type - if blank, all sizes are allowed. Valid values are presented via a list. 0: small, 1: wide, 2: large.
Names of the contents that display on the Tile. Used on advanced tiles like Inbox.

The Tile icon can be specified using this property or the awp0Icon. This property specifies the persistent TC object containing the icon image file. This is easier to configure for a custom icon than awp0Icon.
The action type of tile. Valid values are presented via a list. 0: default, 1: external link, 2: static resource, 3: command.

Property awp0ShowParticipants is a runtime property of string array type. Property awp0ShowParticipants will list all the participant types which should be shown in the Participants page of the EPMTask. If the storage of the participants is the workflow job then it gets its value by combining the values of existing properties fnd0OptionalParticipants and fnd0RequiredParticipants on the root task template. If the storage of the participants is the target then it will return the first target's allowable participant types that are also part of fnd0OptionalParticpants and fnd0RequiredParticipants on the root task template. The value can be null.
This is a runtime boolean property that reflects if the current user can demote this task.

Condition.description: Abort Task Command Condition
Condition.expression: (task != NULL AND ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj(task, "root_task", "real_state") != "Aborted") AND ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj(task, "root_task", "real_state") != "Completed") AND ((task.owning_user=u.user) OR (task.fnd0Assignee=u.user) OR (task.active_surrogate=u.user))) OR (signoff != NULL AND ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj(signoff.fnd0ParentTask, "root_task", "real_state") != "Aborted") AND ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj(signoff.fnd0ParentTask, "root_task", "real_state") != "Completed") AND ((signoff.fnd0ParentTask.owning_user=u.user) OR ((signoff.fnd0ParentTask.active_surrogate != NULL) AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.active_surrogate=u.user)) OR ((signoff.fnd0ParentTask.fnd0Assignee != NULL) AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.fnd0Assignee=u.user))))
Condition.name: Awp0AbortTaskCmdCond

Condition.description: The condition checks if Awp0AddReviewer command should be visible. This condition determines if the condition Fnd0AddReviewerPrivilege evaluates to true or false.
Condition.expression: (task != NULL AND Condition::Fnd0AddReviewerPrivilege(u, task)) OR (signoff != NULL AND Condition::Fnd0AddReviewerPrivilege(u, signoff.fnd0ParentTask))
Condition.name: Awp0AddReviewerCmdCond

Condition.description: The condition checks if Awp0AddSurrogate command should be visible. This condition determines if the selected user object represents the currently logged-in user or evaluate the Fnd0ManageSurrogatePrivilege condition for the logged in user.
Condition.name: Awp0AddSurrogateCmdCond

Condition.description: The condition checks if the "Awp0ClaimTask" command should be visible. This condition determines if the condition "Fnd0AssignTaskPrivilege" evaluates to true or false, and also if the logged-in user is a member of the resource pool for EPMTask or Signoff.
Condition.expression: task != NULL AND ( ( u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0IsObjectType( task.fnd0Assignee, "ResourcePool" ) ) AND ( ( task.task_type != "EPMPerformSignoffTask" AND ( Condition::Fnd0AssignTaskPrivilege ( u, task, signoff) OR task.fnd0IsValidPerformer ) ) OR ( task.task_type = "EPMPerformSignoffTask" AND task.awp0CheckSignoffClaimable() ) ) ) OR ( signoff != NULL AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0IsObjectType( signoff.fnd0Assignee, "ResourcePool" ) AND signoff.fnd0ParentTask.task_type = "EPMPerformSignoffTask" AND signoff.awp0CheckSignoffClaimable() )
Condition.name: Awp0ClaimEPMTaskCmdCond

Condition.description: This condition determines the visibility for command to edit Workflow Template
Condition.expression: (o != null) AND (u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0IsObjectType(o,"EPMTaskTemplate") = true) AND ((((((u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue(o,"fnd0IsPrivilegedTemplate","false",false)) AND (Condition::Awp0IsWorkflowTemplateAuthor(u))) OR ((u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue(o,"fnd0IsPrivilegedTemplate","true",false)) AND (Condition::Awp0IsPrivilegedWorkflowTemplateAuthor(u) = true))))) OR ((Condition::Awp0IsWorkflowTemplateAuthor(u)) ))
Condition.name: Awp0EditWorkflowTemplateCmdCond

Condition.description: This condition determines visibility of the command to export Workflow template
Condition.expression: (o != null AND ((u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue(o,"template_stage","2",false)=true) OR (u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0GetPropertyValue(o,"template_stage","1",false)=true)) AND (u.fnd0ConditionHelper.awp0IsObjectType(o,"EPMTaskTemplate") = true) AND (Condition::Awp0EditWorkflowTemplateCmdCond(o,u) = true))

Condition.description: The condition checks if Awp0ReassignTask command should be visible. The condition determines if the root-task of the select object is not completed and it satisfies the Fnd0AssignTaskPrivilege condition.

Condition.expression: ((task != NULL) AND (task.real_state = "Suspended") AND (task.fnd0IsValidPerformer) AND (task.fnd0MyTaskExecutionStatus !=1) ) OR ((signoff != NULL) AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.real_state = "Suspended") AND ( signoff.fnd0ParentTask.fnd0IsValidPerformer) AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.fnd0MyTaskExecutionStatus !=1 ))

Condition.description: The condition checks if Awp0StandIn command should be visible or not. The condition enables the command if the logged-in user is a valid surrogate and active surrogate value of EPMTask or Signoff object is not set.
Condition.expression: ( task != NULL AND task.active_surrogate = NULL AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( task, "fnd0Assignee", "is_valid_surrogate" ) = "true" ) OR ( signoff != NULL AND signoff.active_surrogate = NULL AND u.fnd0ConditionHelper.fnd0getPropValueOnRefObj( signoff, "fnd0Assignee", "is_valid_surrogate" ) = "true" )

Condition.description: This condition determines if the input business object is an EPMTask or Signoff and enable the Suspend command based on current state of the task and based on property fnd0IsValidPerformer.
Condition.expression: ((task != NULL) AND (task.real_state != "Suspended") AND (task.real_state != "Aborted") AND (task.real_state != "Completed") AND (task.fnd0IsValidPerformer) AND (task.fnd0MyTaskExecutionStatus !=1)) OR ( (signoff != NULL) AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.real_state != "Suspended") AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.real_state != "Completed") AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.real_state != "Aborted") AND ( signoff.fnd0ParentTask.fnd0IsValidPerformer) AND (signoff.fnd0ParentTask.fnd0MyTaskExecutionStatus !=1 ))

ServiceInterface.description:
The RevisionRuleAdministration service exposes operations that are used to view, update, create or delete RevisionRule. Common uses for RevisionRule include configuration of product structure, Collaborative Design, Product Configurator, Search.

Use Cases:
This service provides following RevisionRule related use cases in Active Workspace.

Use Case 1: Creation of Revision Rule
In Active Workspace, RevisionRule can be created from “Revision Rules” sub-location where all existing rules along with their clauses will be listed, given that user have privileges to create a RevisionRule.

Use Case 2: Modification of existing Revision Rule:
In Active Workspace, RevisionRules can be modified inside “Revision Rules” sub-location , given that user have privileges to modify a RevisionRule.Clauses of a RevisionRule can be re-ordered to change the precedence by moving the clause up/down using the corresponding controls.New clause from list of available clauses can be added or a clause can be removed from existing list of clauses.

Use Case 3: Modification of existing Revision Rule inside ACE:
Inside ACE (Active Content Experience), adhoc changes to the RevisionRule clauses can be performed to configure product structure. Addition of new clauses, removal of exisiting clauses or re-ordering of the clauses can be done to create a 'modified' version copy of the original RevisionRule which will be available to the current user only.

Use Case 4: View details:
RevisionRule of interest can be viewed in Active Workspace,( inside “Revision Rules” sub-location as well inside of ACE). Details of the clauses and their ordering can be viewed to make the informed decision on configuring the product structure. (This is a frequently used feature in Teamcenter Structure Manager).

Use Case 5: Deletion of Revision Rule:
RevisionRules can be deleted from “Revision Rules” sub-location in Active Workspace, given that user have privileges to delete a RevisionRule.
ServiceInterface.name: RevisionRuleAdministration

StructElement.description:
Indicates type of the entry inside RevisionRule.A RevisionRule is made up of a sequential list of entries. Evaluation of the rule involves evaluating each of the entries, in order, until a configured revision of the Item is successfully obtained. A rule is made up of entries of the following types.
0 - Working
1 - Status
2 - Override
3 - Date
4 - Unit No.
5 - Group
6 - Precise
7 - Latest
8 - End Item
9 - GroupByItemType
10 – Branch.
StructElement.name: entryType

StructElement.description: Display text of the entry.
StructElement.name: displayText

For example: 1: For entry type Working, the map will contain “user”, and “group” as keys and UIDs of User and Group as values respectively. 2: For entry type Status, the map will contain "status_type”as key and UID of attached status i.e TaskType as value. 3: For entry type Override, the map will contain “folder” as key and UID of Folder as value.
StructElement.name: revRuleEntryKeyToValue

Struct.description:
The Effectivity represents a validity range. The following constants have special meaning:
    • January 2, 1900 12:00 AM UTC: Open Start Date.
    • December 30, 9999 12:00 AM UTC: Open End Date.
    • December 26, 9999 12:00 AM UTC: Stock Out.
    • 1: Open Start Unit.
    • 2147483647: Open End Unit.
    • 2147483646: Stock Out.

Effect in as well as effect out points may have NULL values, which indicate no value assigned:
    • -1: no unit value assigned.
    • NULL date: no date value assigned.
Struct.name: Effectivity

StructElement.description: The unit at which validity range starts.
StructElement.name: unitIn

StructElement.description: The unit at which validity range ends.
StructElement.name: unitOut

StructElement.description: The date at which validity range starts.
StructElement.name: dateIn

StructElement.description: The date at which validity range ends.
StructElement.name: dateOut

StructElement.description: The effectivity end Item. This is mandatory if unit range is specified.
StructElement.name: endItem

StructElement.description:
A list of EffectivityOption for which the effectivity range is valid (optional). The valid effectivity options are available on the effectivity context associated with with product Item with relation Fnd0ProductEffConfigCxtRel.
For example, effectivity context with item id EFFCTX001 is associated with product Item. It has option families defined with names Maturity Intent and Module Intent. Maturity Intent has values Design and Production. Module Intent has values Kit and Modkit. The effectivity options can be specified as:
    • familyNamespace=EFFCTX001, familyName=Maturity Intent, optionValue=Design, opCode=5
    • familyNamespace=EFFCTX001, familyName=Module Intent, optionValue=Kit, opCode=5
StructElement.name: effectivityOptions

Struct.description: The EffectivityInfo structure represents effectivity for a BusinessObject.
Struct.name: EffectivityInfo

StructElement.description: A unique string to identify returned BusinessObject and partial errors associated with input.
StructElement.name: clientId

StructElement.description: The BusinessObject to which effectivity information to be associated. Supported types are: ItemRevision and Awb0Element.
StructElement.name: inputObject

StructElement.description: A list of <font face="courier" height="10">Effectivity</font> for an <font face="courier" height="10">inputObject</font>.
StructElement.name: effectivity

StructElement.description:
The effectivity formula for an inputObject. Either effectivity or effectivityFormula can be specified while setting the effectivity. If both are specified, effectivity is ignored.
For example, for unit range 1 to 10 the corresponding formula is ([Teamcenter::]Unit >= 1 & [Teamcenter::]Unit < 11 ) & [Teamcenter::]EndItem = “HDD-Top”
StructElement.name: effectivityFormula

Struct.description: The EffectivityInfoInput structure represents BusinessObject and its effectivity to be set.
Struct.name: EffectivityInfoInput

StructElement.description: The effectivity context to be associated with the inputObject in effectivityData (optional). If effectivityContext is specified, a new Fnd0ProductEffConfigCxtRel relation is created between inputObject and effectivityContext. Supported context types are: Item and ItemRevision. The context is considered only when inputObject is of type ItemRevision and is ignored if inputObject is of type Awb0Element. If NULL, effectivity context is not associated with inputObject.
StructElement.name: effectivityContext

Struct.description: The <font face="courier" height="10">EffectivityOption</font> structure represents an additional effectivity validity along with date and unit effectivity ranges.
Struct.name: EffectivityOption

StructElement.description:
The namespace by which the effectivity option family is uniquely identified. The familyNamespace is the item id of effectivity context associated with product Item with relation Fnd0ProductEffConfigCxtRel.
For example, effectivity context with item id EFFCTX001 is associated with product Item. It has option families defined with names Maturity Intent and Module Intent. Maturity Intent has values Design and Production. Module Intent has values Kit and Modkit. The familyNamespace can be EFFCTX001.
StructElement.name: familyNamespace

StructElement.description:
The name of the effectivity option family. The valid option family names are available on the effectivity context associated with with product Item with relation Fnd0ProductEffConfigCxtRel.
For example, effectivity context with item id EFFCTX001 is associated with product Item. It has option families defined with names Maturity Intent and Module Intent. Maturity Intent has values Design and Production. Module Intent has values Kit and Modkit. The familyNamespace is set as EFFCTX001. The familyName can be either Maturity Intent or Module Intent.
StructElement.name: familyName

StructElement.description:
The operator to be used for the optionValue.
The valid values are:
    • 5 – Equals
    • 6 – Not Equals
StructElement.name: opCode

StructElement.description:
The value for the effectivity option. The valid option values for given familyNamespace and familyName are available on the effectivity context associated with product Item with relation Fnd0ProductEffConfigCxtRel.
For example, effectivity context with item id EFFCTX001 is associated with product Item. It has option families defined with names Maturity Intent and Module Intent. Maturity Intent has values Design and Production. Module Intent has values Kit and Modkit. The familyNamespace is set as EFFCTX001. The familyName is set Maturity Intent. The optionValue can be either Design or Production.
StructElement.name: optionValue

OperationTemplate.description: Imports an Excel file into Teamcenter and creates the product structure and sets the properties on objects based on the values given in Excel file. The input Excel file contains a level column to indicate the level of the object in the structure. ”Level” and “Object Type” columns are mandatory in the input Excel sheet. The input Excel file is parsed to import the data to create product structure in Teamcenter. This operation supports the creation of objects only. Update and Delete are not supported. The column headers in excel are mapped to their respective properties which are saved as a mapping group on “import”. This operation support create and update of mapping groups.

OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The column headers and property information after parsing the input file and a ServiceData element.

The following partial errors may be returned:
223509    The selected input file does not have mandatory columns “Tc_Level” and “Tc_ObjectType”.
223510    The header information in the selected input file does not match with the mapping input data.
223511    The input type provided contains required properties which are not supplied in the input Excel file.
223512    The input type provided contains MFK properties which are not supplied in the input Excel file.
223518    The creation or updation of mapping group failed.

OperationParameter.description: A list of type and property related data and the file ticket of the Excel file to imported.
OperationParameter.name: importExcelData

Operation.useCase:
Use case 1: User adding effectivity on the object having no existing effectivity.

Input:
Target Object existing effectivity: None
New Effectivity: Unit In = 3 & Unit Out = 9 & Intent = Design
Resultant Effectivity set on the object: Unit In = 3 & Unit Out = 9 & Intent = Design

Use case 2: User adding effectivity on the object having existing effectivity.

Input:
Target Object existing effectivity: Unit In = 3 & Unit Out = 9 & Intent = Design
New Effectivity: Unit In = 15 & Unit Out = 20 & Intent = Design
Resultant Effectivity set on the object: ( Unit In = 3 & Unit Out = 9 & Intent = Design ) OR ( Unit In = 15 & Unit Out = 20 & Intent = Design )

Use case 3: User adding effectivity on the object having existing effectivity. The new effectivity is overlapping with existing effectivity values.

Input:
Target Object existing effectivity: Unit In = 3 & Unit Out = 9 & Intent = Design
New Effectivity: Unit In = 5 & Unit Out = 20 & Intent = Design
Resultant Effectivity set on the object: Unit In = 5 & Unit Out = 20 & Intent = Design

ParameterInfo.description: The BusinessObjects with their effectivity data to be authored. The objects must of type ItemRevision or Awb0Element.

Operation.useCase:
•    Add a new file to existing DocumentRevision business object.
In Active Workspace Client, when opening a DocumentRevison business object in the Overview tab, under the "FILES" section, there is an "Add to" button the user can click to add a new file to the DocumentRevision object. For example, if the “Fnd0GenerateDSNameWithoutExt” business constant for DocumentRevision is false, then the Dataset name will be looked like “test.docx”.

• Drag and drop a file to an existing DocumentRevision business object.
In Active Workspace Client, when opening a DocumentRevison business object in the Overview tab, under the "FILES" section, user can drag and drop a file into the section, that will add a new file to the DocumentRevision object. For example, if the “Fnd0GenerateDSNameWithoutExt” business constant for DocumentRevision is true, then the Dataset name will be looked like “test”.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of GenerateDsNameInput which contains the WorkspaceObject object, a list of file name and relation name pairs and any additional information (name/value pair) used to generate the Dataset names.

OperationTemplate.description: This operation processes (load or save) the markups or stamps on the server.

OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Return the common MarkupResponse that contains the version, message, updated base object, updated markups, and possibly partial errors.

The following partial errors may be returned in the ServiceData:
    • 499000 The base object <OBJECT_NAME> is not supported for markups.
    • 499001 The markups cannot be created or modified because the base object is checked-out by user <USER_NAME>.
    • 499002 The markups cannot be created or modified because the markups data is currently updated by user <USER_NAME>.
    • 499003 The "View/Markup" action cannot be completed on the Dataset with version number <VERSION_NUMBER>. It can only be done on the current version of the Dataset: <VERSION_NUMBER>.
    • 499004 The base Dataset <DATASET_NAME> does not have a named reference. The View/Markup action requires the base Dataset to have a named reference.
    • 499005 The Dataset <DATASET_NAME> was marked up by the Rich, Thin or Office clients View/Markup action. Please use one of these clients to perform the View/Markup action on this Dataset.
    • 515024 The given tag <TAG> does not exist in the database or is not a persistent object tag.

OperationTemplate.description: Imports an Excel file into Teamcenter and creates the Requirement structure and sets the properties on objects based on the values given in Excel file. The input Excel file contains a level column to indicate the level of the object in the structure. ”Level” and “Object Type” columns are mandatory in the input Excel sheet. The input Excel file is parsed to import the data to create Requirement structure in Teamcenter. This operation supports the creation of objects only. Update and Delete are not supported. OperationTemplate.description: This operation gets the filtered list of organization objects Group, Role, User, GroupMember in hierachical manner and updated filter category values for a given filter criteria.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::OrgMgmt::OrganizationManagement::getFilteredOrganizationTree
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
This operation returns the Group, Role, User in hierarchical manner along with the GroupMember information which represents a filtered organization tree for a given input filter, search and sort criteria.

Possible errors returned are:

    • 516001 - An enquiry internal error has occurred.
    • 516127 - The enquiry module has run out of memory.
    • 516130 - The enquiry has timed-out.


Use Case 1: User performs search by entering a keyword in content search input box - 'dba'

A search request will be made by passing the searchCriteria with 'searchString':'value'. Value would be the keyword user has typed in. The results will return all the Group,Role,User nodes which contain the string 'dba' in it and they are displayed in tree mode.
The result also contains the filter category values based on the search results.

Use Case 2: A User performs a search by selecting filter value from filter panel: Group = dba

A search request will be made by passing filter criteria in searchFilterMap. The results will return ‘dba’ Group node and it is displayed in tree mode.
The result also contains the filter category values based on the search results.

StructElement.description: Map (string, list of strings) of column name to an ordered list of task UIDs. This value will be returned if returnColumnInfo value is true.
StructElement.name: columnTasksOrder

StructElement.description: ServiceData containing a list of all partial errors.
StructElement.name: serviceData

OperationTemplate.description: This operation creates or updates the Kanban board configuration for a given context, e.g., User or TC_Project, and board filters MyTasks or ProjectTasks. It allows the caller to store how tasks are grouped, filtered, and ordered for visualization in a Kanban board.
OperationTemplate.name: Awp0::Soa::TaskManagement::TaskManagementAw::manageKanbanConfiguration
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The updated configuration and task-ordering information.
The following partial errors may be returned:
-    39014: The specified type Simple Task does not exist.
-    38015: Unable to find a property with name State.

OperationParameter.description: The input structure contains configuration details for the Kanban board.
OperationParameter.name: manageKanbanConfigInput
